35.11: Where is the one who makes us wiser than the animals and birds?'
35.12: "And if they do cry out and God does not answer, it is because of their pride.
35.13: But it is wrong to say God doesn't listen, to say the Almighty isn't concerned.
35.14: And it is even more false to say he doesn't see what is going on. He will bring about justice if you will only wait.
35.15: But do you cry out against him because he does not respond in anger?
35.16: Job, you have protested in vain. You have spoken like a fool."

36.2: "Let me go on, and I will show you the truth of what I am saying. For I have not finished defending God!
36.3: I will give you many illustrations of the righteousness of my Creator.
36.4: I am telling you the honest truth, for I am a man of well-rounded knowledge.
36.5: "God is mighty, yet he does not despise anyone! He is mighty in both power and understanding.
36.6: He does not let the wicked live but gives justice to the afflicted.
36.7: His eyes never leave the innocent, but he establishes and exalts them with kings forever.
36.8: If troubles come upon them and they are enslaved and afflicted,
36.9: he takes the trouble to show them the reason. He shows them their sins, for they have behaved proudly.
36.10: He gets their attention and says they must turn away from evil.
36.11: "If they listen and obey God, then they will be blessed with prosperity throughout their lives. All their years will be pleasant.
36.12: But if they refuse to listen to him, they will perish in battle and die from lack of understanding.
36.13: For the godless are full of resentment. Even when he punishes them, they refuse to cry out to him for help.
36.14: They die young after wasting their lives in immoral living.
36.15: But by means of their suffering, he rescues those who suffer. For he gets their attention through adversity.
36.16: "God has led you away from danger, giving you freedom. You have prospered in a wide and pleasant valley.
36.17: But you are too obsessed with judgment on the godless. Don't worry, justice will be upheld.
36.18: But watch out, or you may be seduced with wealth. Don't let yourself be bribed into sin.
36.19: Could all your wealth and mighty efforts keep you from distress?
36.20: Do not long for the cover of night, for that is when people will be destroyed.
36.21: Be on guard! Turn back from evil, for it was to prevent you from getting into a life of evil that God sent this suffering.
36.22: "Look, God is all-powerful. Who is a teacher like him?
36.23: No one can tell him what to do. No one can say to him, `You have done wrong.'
36.24: Instead, glorify his mighty works, singing songs of praise.
36.25: Everyone has seen these things, but only from a distance.
36.26: "Look, God is exalted beyond what we can understand. His years are without number.
36.27: He draws up the water vapor and then distills it into rain.
36.28: The rain pours down from the clouds, and everyone benefits from it.
36.29: Can anyone really understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunder that rolls forth from heaven?
36.30: See how he spreads the lightning around him and how it lights up the depths of the sea.
36.31: By his mighty acts he governs the people, giving them food in abundance.
36.32: He fills his hands with lightning bolts. He hurls each at its target.
36.33: The thunder announces his presence; the storm announces his indignant anger.

37.1: "My heart pounds as I think of this. It leaps within me.
37.2: Listen carefully to the thunder of God's voice as it rolls from his mouth.
37.3: It rolls across the heavens, and his lightning flashes out in every direction.
37.4: Then comes the roaring of the thunder--the tremendous voice of his majesty. He does not restrain the thunder when he speaks.
37.5: God's voice is glorious in the thunder. We cannot comprehend the greatness of his power.
37.6: "He directs the snow to fall on the earth and tells the rain to pour down.
37.7: Everyone stops working at such a time so they can recognize his power.
37.8: The wild animals hide in the rocks or in their dens.
37.9: The stormy wind comes from its chamber, and the driving winds bring the cold.
37.10: God's breath sends the ice, freezing wide expanses of water.
37.11: He loads the clouds with moisture, and they flash with his lightning.
37.12: The clouds turn around and around under his direction. They do whatever he commands throughout the earth.
37.13: He causes things to happen on earth, either as a punishment or as a sign of his unfailing love.
37.14: "Listen, Job; stop and consider the wonderful miracles of God!
37.15: Do you know how God controls the storm and causes the lightning to flash forth from his clouds?
37.16: Do you understand how he balances the clouds with wonderful perfection and skill?
37.17: When you are sweltering in your clothes and the south wind dies down and everything is still,
37.18: he makes the skies reflect the heat like a giant mirror. Can you do that?
37.19: "You think you know so much, so teach the rest of us what to say to God. We are too ignorant to make our own arguments.
37.20: Should God be told that I want to speak? Can we speak when we are confused?
37.21: We cannot look at the sun, for it shines brightly in the sky when the wind clears away the clouds.
37.22: Golden splendor comes from the mountain of God. He is clothed in dazzling splendor.
37.23: We cannot imagine the power of the Almighty, yet he is so just and merciful that he does not oppress us.
37.24: No wonder people everywhere fear him. People who are truly wise show him reverence."

38.1: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind:
38.2: "Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorant words?
38.3: Brace yourself, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
38.4: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell me, if you know so much.
38.5: Do you know how its dimensions were determined and who did the surveying?
38.6: What supports its foundations, and who laid its cornerstone
38.7: as the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?
38.8: "Who defined the boundaries of the sea as it burst from the womb,
38.9: and as I clothed it with clouds and thick darkness?
38.10: For I locked it behind barred gates, limiting its shores.
38.11: I said, `Thus far and no farther will you come. Here your proud waves must stop!'
38.12: "Have you ever commanded the morning to appear and caused the dawn to rise in the east?
38.13: Have you ever told the daylight to spread to the ends of the earth, to bring an end to the night's wickedness?
38.14: For the features of the earth take shape as the light approaches, and the dawn is robed in red.
38.15: The light disturbs the haunts of the wicked, and it stops the arm that is raised in violence.
38.16: "Have you explored the springs from which the seas come? Have you walked about and explored their depths?
38.17: Do you know where the gates of death are located? Have you seen the gates of utter gloom?
38.18: Do you realize the extent of the earth? Tell me about it if you know!
38.19: "Where does the light come from, and where does the darkness go?
38.20: Can you take it to its home? Do you know how to get there?
38.21: But of course you know all this! For you were born before it was all created, and you are so very experienced!
38.22: "Have you visited the treasuries of the snow? Have you seen where the hail is made and stored?
38.23: I have reserved it for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war.
38.24: Where is the path to the origin of light? Where is the home of the east wind?
38.25: "Who created a channel for the torrents of rain? Who laid out the path for the lightning?
38.26: Who makes the rain fall on barren land, in a desert where no one lives?
38.27: Who sends the rain that satisfies the parched ground and makes the tender grass spring up?
38.28: "Does the rain have a father? Where does dew come from?
38.29: Who is the mother of the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens?
38.30: For the water turns to ice as hard as rock, and the surface of the water freezes.
38.31: "Can you hold back the movements of the stars? Are you able to restrain the Pleiades or Orion?
38.32: Can you ensure the proper sequence of the seasons or guide the constellation of the Bear with her cubs across the heavens?
38.33: Do you know the laws of the universe and how God rules the earth?
38.34: "Can you shout to the clouds and make it rain?
38.35: Can you make lightning appear and cause it to strike as you direct it?
38.37: Who is wise enough to count all the clouds? Who can tilt the water jars of heaven,
38.38: turning the dry dust to clumps of mud?
38.39: "Can you stalk prey for a lioness and satisfy the young lions' appetites
38.40: as they lie in their dens or crouch in the thicket?
38.41: Who provides food for the ravens when their young cry out to God as they wander about in hunger?

39.1: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Have you watched as the wild deer are born?
39.2: Do you know how many months they carry their young? Are you aware of the time of their delivery?
39.3: They crouch down to give birth to their young and deliver their offspring.
39.4: Their young grow up in the open fields, then leave their parents and never return.
39.6: I have placed it in the wilderness; its home is the wasteland.
39.7: It hates the noise of the city, and it has no driver to shout at it.
39.8: The mountains are its pastureland, where it searches for every blade of grass.
39.9: "Will the wild ox consent to being tamed? Will it stay in your stall?
39.10: Can you hitch a wild ox to a plow? Will it plow a field for you?
39.11: Since it is so strong, can you trust it? Can you go away and trust the ox to do your work?
39.12: Can you rely on it to return, bringing your grain to the threshing floor?
39.13: "The ostrich flaps her wings grandly, but they are no match for the feathers of the stork.
39.14: She lays her eggs on top of the earth, letting them be warmed in the dust.
39.15: She doesn't worry that a foot might crush them or that wild animals might destroy them.
39.16: She is harsh toward her young, as if they were not her own. She is unconcerned though they die,
39.17: for God has deprived her of wisdom. He has given her no understanding.
39.18: But whenever she jumps up to run, she passes the swiftest horse with its rider.
39.19: "Have you given the horse its strength or clothed its neck with a flowing mane?
39.20: Did you give it the ability to leap forward like a locust? Its majestic snorting is something to hear!
39.21: It paws the earth and rejoices in its strength. When it charges to war,
39.22: it is unafraid. It does not run from the sword.
39.23: The arrows rattle against it, and the spear and javelin flash.
39.24: Fiercely it paws the ground and rushes forward into battle when the trumpet blows.
39.25: It snorts at the sound of the bugle. It senses the battle even at a distance. It quivers at the noise of battle and the shout of the captain's commands.
39.26: "Are you the one who makes the hawk soar and spread its wings to the south?
39.27: Is it at your command that the eagle rises to the heights to make its nest?
39.28: It lives on the cliffs, making its home on a distant, rocky crag.
39.29: From there it hunts its prey, keeping watch with piercing eyes.
39.30: Its nestlings gulp down blood, for it feeds on the carcass of the slaughtered."

40.1: Then the LORD said to Job,
40.2: "Do you still want to argue with the Almighty? You are God's critic, but do you have the answers?"
40.3: Then Job replied to the LORD,
40.4: "I am nothing--how could I ever find the answers? I will put my hand over my mouth in silence.
40.5: I have said too much already. I have nothing more to say."
40.6: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind:
40.7: "Brace yourself, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
40.8: Are you going to discredit my justice and condemn me so you can say you are right?
40.9: Are you as strong as God, and can you thunder with a voice like his?
40.10: All right then, put on your robes of state, your majesty and splendor.
40.11: Give vent to your anger. Let it overflow against the proud.
40.12: Humiliate the proud with a glance; walk on the wicked where they stand.
40.13: Bury them in the dust. Imprison them in the world of the dead.
40.14: Then even I would praise you, for your own strength would save you.
40.15: "Take a look at the mighty hippopotamus. I made it, just as I made you. It eats grass like an ox.
40.16: See its powerful loins and the muscles of its belly.
40.17: Its tail is as straight as a cedar. The sinews of its thighs are tightly knit together.
40.18: Its bones are tubes of bronze. Its limbs are bars of iron.
40.19: It is a prime example of God's amazing handiwork. Only its Creator can threaten it.
40.20: The mountains offer it their best food, where all the wild animals play.
40.21: It lies down under the lotus plants, hidden by the reeds.
40.22: The lotus plants give it shade among the willows beside the stream.
40.23: It is not disturbed by raging rivers, not even when the swelling Jordan rushes down upon it.
40.24: No one can catch it off guard or put a ring in its nose and lead it away.

41.1: "Can you catch a crocodile with a hook or put a noose around its jaw?
41.2: Can you tie it with a rope through the nose or pierce its jaw with a spike?
41.3: Will it beg you for mercy or implore you for pity?
41.4: Will it agree to work for you? Can you make it be your slave for life?
41.5: Can you make it a pet like a bird, or give it to your little girls to play with?
41.6: Will merchants try to buy it? Will they sell it in their shops?
41.7: Will its hide be hurt by darts, or its head by a harpoon?
41.8: If you lay a hand on it, you will never forget the battle that follows, and you will never try it again!
41.9: "No, it is useless to try to capture it. The hunter who attempts it will be thrown down.
41.10: And since no one dares to disturb the crocodile, who would dare to stand up to me?
41.11: Who will confront me and remain safe? Everything under heaven is mine.
41.12: "I want to emphasize the tremendous strength in the crocodile's limbs and throughout its enormous frame.
41.13: Who can strip off its hide, and who can penetrate its double layer of armor?
41.14: Who could pry open its jaws? For its teeth are terrible!
41.15: The overlapping scales on its back make a shield.
41.16: They are close together so no air can get between them.
41.17: They lock together so nothing can penetrate them.
41.18: "When it sneezes, it flashes light! Its eyes are like the red of dawn.
41.19: Fire and sparks leap from its mouth.
41.20: Smoke streams from its nostrils like steam from a boiling pot on a fire of dry rushes.
41.21: Yes, its breath would kindle coals, for flames shoot from its mouth.
41.22: "The tremendous strength in its neck strikes terror wherever it goes.
41.23: Its flesh is hard and firm, not soft and fat.
41.24: Its heart is as hard as rock, as hard as a millstone.
41.25: When it rises, the mighty are afraid, gripped by terror.
41.26: No sword can stop it, nor spear nor dart nor pointed shaft.
41.27: To the crocodile, iron is nothing but straw, and bronze is rotten wood.
41.28: Arrows cannot make it flee. Stones shot from a sling are as ineffective as straw.
41.29: Clubs do no good, and it laughs at the swish of the javelins.
41.30: Its belly is covered with scales as sharp as glass. They tear up the ground as it drags through the mud.
41.31: "The crocodile makes the water boil with its commotion. It churns the depths.
41.32: The water glistens in its wake. One would think the sea had turned white.
41.33: There is nothing else so fearless anywhere on earth.
41.34: Of all the creatures, it is the proudest. It is the king of beasts."

42.1: Then Job replied to the LORD:
42.2: "I know that you can do anything, and no one can stop you.
42.3: You ask, `Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorance?' It is I. And I was talking about things I did not understand, things far too wonderful for me.
42.4: "You said, `Listen and I will speak! I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.'
42.5: "I had heard about you before, but now I have seen you with my own eyes.
42.6: I take back everything I said, and I sit in dust and ashes to show my repentance."
42.7: After the LORD had finished speaking to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite: "I am angry with you and with your two friends, for you have not been right in what you said about me, as my servant Job was.
42.8: Now take seven young bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and offer a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer on your behalf. I will not treat you as you deserve, for you have not been right in what you said about me, as my servant Job was."
42.9: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite did as the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job's prayer.
42.10: When Job prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his fortunes. In fact, the LORD gave him twice as much as before!
42.11: Then all his brothers, sisters, and former friends came and feasted with him in his home. And they consoled him and comforted him because of all the trials the LORD had brought against him. And each of them brought him a gift of money and a gold ring.
42.12: So the LORD blessed Job in the second half of his life even more than in the beginning. For now he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand teams of oxen, and one thousand female donkeys.
42.13: He also gave Job seven more sons and three more daughters.
42.14: He named his first daughter Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.
42.15: In all the land there were no other women as lovely as the daughters of Job. And their father put them into his will along with their brothers.
42.16: Job lived 140 years after that, living to see four generations of his children and grandchildren.
42.17: Then he died, an old man who had lived a long, good life.

1.1: What delight comes to the one who follows God’s ways! He won’t walk in step with the wicked, nor share the sinner’s way, nor be found sitting in the scorner’s seat.
1.2: His passion is to remain true to the Word of “I AM,” meditating day and night on the true revelation of light.
1.3: He will be standing firm like a flourishing tree planted by God’s design, deeply rooted by the brooks of bliss, bearing fruit in every season of life. He is never dry, never fainting, ever blessed, ever prosperous.
1.4: But how different are the wicked. They are like chaff blown away by the wind.
1.5: The wicked will not endure the day of judgment, for God will not defend them. Nothing they do will succeed or endure for long, for they have no part with those who walk in truth.
1.6: But how different it is for the righteous! The Lord embraces their paths as they move forward while the way of the wicked leads only to doom.

2.1: How dare the nations plan a rebellion. Their foolish plots are futile!
2.2: Look at how the power brokers of the world rise up to hold their summit as the rulers scheme and confer together against Yahweh and his Anointed King, saying:
2.3: “Let’s come together and break away from the Creator. Once and for all let’s cast off these controlling chains of God and his Christ!”
2.4: God-Enthroned merely laughs at them; the Sovereign One mocks their madness!
2.5: Then with the fierceness of his fiery anger, he settles the issue and terrifies them to death with these words:
2.6: “I myself have poured out my King on Zion, my holy mountain.”
2.7: “I will reveal the eternal purpose of God. For he has decreed over me, ‘You are my favored Son. And as your Father I have crowned you as my King Eternal. Today I became your Father.
2.8: Ask me to give you the nations and I will do it, and they shall become your legacy. Your domain will stretch to the ends of the earth.
2.9: And you will shepherd them with unlimited authority, crushing their rebellion as an iron rod smashes jars of clay!’ ”
2.10: “Listen to me, all you rebel kings and all you upstart judges of the earth. Learn your lesson while there’s still time.
2.11: Serve and worship the awe-inspiring God. Recognize his greatness and bow before him, trembling with reverence in his presence.
2.12: Fall facedown before him and kiss the Son before his anger is roused against you. Remember that his wrath can be quickly kindled! But many blessings are waiting for all who turn aside to hide themselves in him!”

3.1: Lord, I have so many enemies, so many who are against me.
3.2: Listen to how they whisper their slander against me, saying: “Look! He’s hopeless! Even God can’t save him from this!”
3.3: But in the depths of my heart I truly know that you, Yahweh, have become my Shield; You take me and surround me with yourself. Your glory covers me continually. You lift high my head.
3.4: I have cried out to you, Yahweh, from your holy presence. You send me a Father’s help.
3.5: So now I’ll lie down and sleep like a baby— then I’ll awake in safety, for you surround me with your glory.
3.6: Even though ten thousand dark powers prowl around me, I won’t be afraid.
3.7: Rise up and help me, Yahweh! Come and save me, God! For you will slap them in the face, breaking the power of their words to harm me.
3.8: For the Lord alone is my Savior. What a feast of favor and bliss he gives his people!

4.1: God, you are my righteousness, my Champion Defender. Answer me when I cry for help! Whenever I was in distress, you enlarged me. I’m being squeezed again—I need your kindness right away! Grant me your grace, hear my prayer, and set me free!
4.2: Listen to me, you elite among men: How long will you defame my honor and drag it down into shame? Will you ever stop insulting me? How long will you set your heart on shadows, chasing your lies and delusions?
4.3: May we never forget that Yahweh works wonders for every one of his devoted lovers. And this is how I know that he will answer my every prayer.
4.4: Tremble in awe before the Lord, and do not sin against him. Be still upon your bed and search your heart before him.
4.5: Bring to Yahweh the sacrifice of righteousness and put your trust in him.
4.6: Lord, prove them wrong when they say, “God can’t help you!” Let the light of your radiant face break through and shine upon us!
4.7: The intense pleasure you give me surpasses the gladness of harvest time, even more than when the harvesters gaze upon their ripened grain and when their new wine overflows.
4.8: Now, because of you, Lord, I will lie down in peace and sleep comes at once, for no matter what happens, I will live unafraid!

5.1: Listen, Yahweh, to my passionate prayer! Can’t you hear my groaning?
5.2: Don’t you hear how I’m crying out to you? My King and my God, consider my every word, for I am calling out to you.
5.3: At each and every sunrise you will hear my voice as I prepare my sacrifice of prayer to you. Every morning I lay out the pieces of my life on the altar and wait for your fire to fall upon my heart.
5.4: I know that you, God, are never pleased with lawlessness, and evil ones will never be invited into your house.
5.5: Boasters collapse, unable to survive your scrutiny, for your hatred of evildoers is clear.
5.6: You will make an end of all those who lie. How you hate their hypocrisy and despise all who love violence!
5.7: But I know that you will welcome me into your house, for I am covered by your covenant of mercy and love. So I come to your sanctuary with deepest awe to bow in worship and adore you.
5.8: Yahweh, lead me in the pathways of your pleasure just like you promised me you would, or else my enemies will conquer me. Smooth out your road in front of me, straight and level, so that I will know where to walk.
5.9: Their words are unreliable. Destruction is in their hearts, drawing people into their darkness with their speeches. They are smooth-tongued deceivers, flattering with their words.
5.10: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their own schemes be their downfall! Let the guilt of their sins collapse on top of them, for they rebel against you.
5.11: But let them all be glad, those who turn aside to hide themselves in you. May they keep shouting for joy forever! Overshadow them in your presence as they sing and rejoice. Then every lover of your name will burst forth with endless joy.
5.12: Lord, how wonderfully you bless the righteous. Your favor wraps around each one and covers them under your canopy of kindness and joy.

6.1: Yahweh, don’t condemn me. Don’t punish me in your fiery anger.
6.2: Please deal gently with me, Yahweh; show me mercy, for I’m sick and frail and weak. Heal me, Yahweh, for I’m falling apart.
6.3: My soul is so troubled; but you, Yahweh —how long?
6.4: Yahweh, turn to me and rescue my life because I know your faithful love will never fail me.
6.5: In the darkness of death who remembers your name in worship? How could I bring you praise if I’m buried in a tomb?
6.6: I’m worn out with my weeping and groaning. Night after night I soak my pillow with tears, and flood my bed with weeping.
6.7: My eyes of faith won’t focus anymore, for sorrow fills my heart. There are so many enemies who come against me!
6.8: Turn from me, all you troublemakers! For Yahweh has turned to hear the sound of my weeping.
6.9: Yes! Yahweh my healer has heard all my pleading and has taken hold of my prayers and answered them all.
6.10: Now it’s my enemies who have been shamed. Terror-stricken, they will turn back again, knowing the bitterness of sudden disgrace!

7.1: Yahweh, my God, I turn to hide my soul in you. Save me from all those who pursue and persecute me.
7.2: There is none to deliver me but you! Don’t let my foes fall upon me like fierce lions with teeth bared. Can’t you see how they want to rip my soul to shreds?
7.3: Yahweh, my God, if I have done evil like they say I have, and my hands are guilty,
7.4: if I have wronged someone at peace with me, if I have betrayed a friend, repaying evil for good, or if I have unjustly harmed my enemy,
7.5: Then let my enemy pursue and overtake me. Let them grind me into the ground. Let them take my life from me and drag my dignity through the dust!
7.6: Yahweh, arise in your anger against the anger of my enemies. Awaken your fury and stand up for me! Execute the judgment you have decreed against them.
7.7: All the people gather around you. Return to your place on high to preside over them.
7.8: You are Yahweh who judges the people. Vindicate me publicly, Yahweh, and restore my honor and integrity. Declare me innocent.
7.9: Once and for all, bring to an end the evil tactics of the wicked! Establish the cause of the righteous, for you are the righteous God, the soul searcher, who tests every heart to examine the thoughts and motives.
7.10: God, your wraparound presence is my shield. You bring victory to all who are pure in heart.
7.11: God, your righteousness is revealed when you judge. Because of the strength of your forgiveness, your anger does not break out every day.
7.12: Yet if one does not repent, you will not relent to sharpen your shining sword. You have an arsenal of lethal weapons that you’ve prepared for them. You have bent and strung your bow, making your judgment-arrows shafts of burning fire.
7.13: He will prepare his deadly weapons and ignite his flaming arrows.
7.14: Look how the wicked conceive their evil schemes. They go into labor with their lies and give birth to trouble.
7.15: They dig a pit for others to fall into, not knowing that they will be the very ones who will fall into it.
7.16: Every pit-digger who works to trap and harm others will be trapped by his own treachery.
7.17: But I will give my thanks to you, Yahweh, for you make everything right in the end. I will sing my highest praise to the God of the Highest Place!

8.1: Yahweh, our Sovereign God, your glory streams from the heavens above, filling the earth with the majesty of your name! People everywhere see your splendor.
8.2: You have built a stronghold by the songs of children. Strength rises up with the chorus of infants. This kind of praise has power to shut Satan’s mouth. Childlike worship will silence the madness of those who oppose you.
8.3: Look at the splendor of your skies, your creative genius glowing in the heavens. When I gaze at your moon and your stars, mounted like jewels in their settings, I know you are the fascinating artist who fashioned it all! But I have to ask this question:
8.4: Why would you bother with puny, mortal man or care about human beings?
8.5: Yet what honor you have given to men, created only a little lower than Elohim, crowned with glory and magnificence.
8.6: You have delegated to them rulership over all you have made, with everything under their authority, placing earth itself under the feet of your image-bearers.
8.7: All the created order and every living thing of the earth, sky, and sea— the wildest beasts and all that move in the paths of the sea — everything is in submission to Adam’s sons.
8.8: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and everything that swims the ocean currents.
8.9: Yahweh, our Sovereign God, your glory streams from the heavens above, filling the earth with the majesty of your name! People everywhere see your splendor!

9.1: I will worship you, Yahweh, with extended hands as my whole heart erupts with praise! I will tell everyone everywhere about your wonderful works!
9.2: I will be glad and shout in triumph. I will sing praise to your exalted name, O Most High.
9.3: For when you appear, I worship you while my enemies run in retreat. They stumble and perish before your presence.
9.4: For you have stood up for my cause and vindicated me when I needed you the most. From your righteous throne you have given me justice.
9.5: With a blast of your rebuke, nations are destroyed. You obliterated their names forever and ever.
9.6: The Lord thundered and our enemies have been cut off, vanished in everlasting ruins. All their cities have been destroyed— even the memory of them has been erased.
9.7: But Yahweh, our mighty God, reigns forever! He sits enthroned as King ready to render his verdicts and judge all with righteousness.
9.8: He will issue his decrees of judgment, deciding what is right for the entire world, dispensing justice to all.
9.9: All who are oppressed may come to Yahweh as a high shelter in the time of trouble, a perfect hiding place.
9.10: For everyone who knows your wonderful name keeps putting their trust in you. They can count on you for help no matter what. O Lord, you will never, no never, neglect those who come to you.
9.11: Listen, everyone! Sing out your praises to the God who rules in Zion! Tell the world about all the miracles he has done!
9.12: He tracks down killers and avenges bloodshed, but he will never forget the ones forgotten by others, hearing every one of their cries for justice.
9.13: So now, O Lord, don’t forget me. Have mercy on me. Take note of how I’ve been humiliated at the hands of those who hate me. You are the one who can snatch me away from the gates of death.
9.14: Then I will sing your praises as I pass through the gates of the Daughter of Zion, rejoicing in your deliverance!
9.15: For the nations get trapped in the very snares they set for others. The hidden trap they set for the weak has snapped shut upon themselves!
9.16: Yahweh is famous for his justice. While the wicked are digging a pit for others, they are actually setting the terms for their own judgment. They will fall into their own pit.
9.17: Don’t forget this: all the wicked will one day fall into the darkness of death’s domain, including the nations that forget God and reject his ways.
9.18: He will not forget the needs of the poor. One day the needy will be remembered, and their hopes will not be forever dashed in disappointment.
9.19: Yahweh, it’s time to arise and judge the nations who defy you. Don’t let rebellious men triumph.
9.20: Make them tremble in fear before your presence. Place a lawgiver over them. Make them know that they are only puny, frail humans who must give account to you!

10.1: Lord, why do you seem so far away when evil is near? Why have you hidden yourself when I need you the most?
10.2: The arrogant in their elitist pride persecute the poor and helpless. May you pour out upon them the very evil they’ve dreamed up against others!
10.3: How they brag and boast of their cravings, exalting the greedy. They congratulate themselves as they despise you—
10.4: these arrogant ones, so smug and secure! In their delusion the wicked boast, saying, “God doesn’t care about what we do. There’s nothing to worry about!”
10.5: So successful are they in their schemes and prosperous in all their plans! Your laws are far from them; they scoff at their enemies.
10.6: They boast that neither God nor men will bring them down. They sneer at all their enemies, saying in their hearts, “We’ll have success in all we do and never have to face trouble.”
10.7: Their mouths spew out cursing, lies, and threats. Only trouble and turmoil come from all their plans.
10.8: Like beasts lurking in the shadows of the city, they crouch silently in ambush, waiting for the innocent to pass by. Pouncing on the poor, they catch them in their snare to murder their prey in secret as they plunder their helpless victims.
10.9: Like lions they crouch silently, waiting to pounce on the helpless. Like hunters they capture their victims and drag them away in nets.
10.10: They crush the lowly as they fall beneath their brutal blows, watching their victims collapse in defeat!
10.11: Then they say to themselves, “The Lofty One is not watching while we do this. He doesn’t even care! We can get away with it!”
10.12: Now arise, Yahweh -God! Crush them once and for all! Don’t forget the helpless and oppressed.
10.13: How dare the wicked think they’ll reject God and escape judgment. They say to themselves, “God won’t hold me accountable.”
10.14: Lord, I know you see all that they’re doing, noting their each and every deed. You know the trouble and turmoil they’ve caused. Now punish them thoroughly for all that they’ve done! The poor and helpless ones trust in you, Lord, for you are famous for being the helper of the fatherless. I know you won’t let them down.
10.15: Break the power of the wicked and all their strong-arm tactics. Search them out and destroy them for the evil things they’ve done.
10.16: You, Yahweh, are King forever and ever! All the nations will perish from your land.
10.17: Yahweh, you have heard the desires of the humble and seen their hopes. You will hear their cries and encourage their hearts.
10.18: The orphans and the oppressed will be terrified no longer, for you will bring them justice, and no earth-dweller will trouble them again.

11.1: My faith shelters my soul continually in Yahweh. Why would you say to me: “ Run away while you can! Fly away like a bird to hide in the mountains for safety.
11.2: For your enemies have prepared a trap for you! Can’t you see them hiding in their place of darkness and shadows? They’re set against all those who live upright lives.
11.3: What can the righteous accomplish when truth’s pillars are destroyed and law and order collapse?”
11.4: Yet Yahweh is never shaken — he is still found in his temple of holiness, reigning as King Yahweh over all. He closely watches and examines everything man does. With a glance, his eyes examine every heart, for his heavenly rule will prevail over all.
11.5: Yahweh tests both the righteous and the wicked. God’s very soul detests lovers of violence.
11.6: He will rain down upon them judgment for their sins. A scorching wind will be their lot in life.
11.7: But remember this: Yahweh is the Righteous One who loves justice, and every godly one will gaze upon his face!

12.1: Help, Lord! Save us! For godly ones are disappearing. Where are the dependable, principled ones? They’re a vanishing breed!
12.2: Everyone lies, everyone flatters, and everyone deceives. Nothing but empty talk, smooth talk, and double-talk.
12.3: You will destroy every proud liar who says, “We lie all we want. Our words are our weapons, and we won’t be held accountable. Who can stop us?” May Yahweh cut off their twisted tongues and seal their lying lips. May they all be silenced—those who boast and brag with their high-minded talk.
12.4: They say, "We will lie to our hearts' content. Our lips are our own--who can stop us?"
12.5: But the Lord says, “Now I will arise! I will defend the poor, those who were plundered, the oppressed, and the needy who groan for help. I will spring into action to rescue and protect them!”
12.6: For every word Yahweh speaks is sure and reliable. His truth is tested, found to be flawless, and ever faithful. It’s as pure as silver refined seven times in a crucible of clay.
12.7: Lord, you will keep us safe, out of the reach of the wicked. Even though they strut and prowl, tolerating and celebrating what is worthless and vile, you will still lift up those who are yours!
12.8: even though the wicked strut about, and evil is praised throughout the land.

13.1: I’m hurting, Lord—will you forget me forever? How much longer, Lord? Will you look the other way when I’m in need?
13.2: How much longer must I cling to this constant grief? I’ve endured this shaking of my soul. So how much longer will my enemy have the upper hand?
13.3: Take a good look at me, Yahweh, my God, and answer me! Breathe your life into my spirit. Bring light to my eyes in this pitch-black darkness or I will sleep the sleep of death.
13.4: Don’t let my enemy proclaim, “I’ve prevailed over him.” For all my adversaries will celebrate when I fall.
13.5: I have always trusted in your kindness, so answer me. I will spin in a circle of joy when your salvation lifts me up.
13.6: I will sing my song of joy to you, Yahweh, for in all of this you have strengthened my soul. My enemies say that I have no Savior, but I know that I have one in you!

14.1: Only the withering soul would say to himself, “There is no God.” Anyone who thinks like this is corrupt and callous, devoid of what is good.
14.2: Yahweh looks down in love, looking over all of Adam’s sons and daughters. He’s looking to see if there is anyone who acts wisely, any who are searching for God and wanting to please him.
14.3: But everyone has wandered astray, walking stubbornly toward evil. Not one is good; he can’t even find one.
14.4: They live in luxury while exploiting my people! Won’t these workers of wickedness ever learn? They don’t ever think of praying to God.
14.5: But look at them now, in panic, trembling with terror. For God is on the side of his godly lovers.
14.6: Yahweh is always the safest place for the poor when the workers of wickedness oppress them.
14.7: How I wish that Israel’s rescue would arise from the midst of Zion! When Yahweh restores his people, Jacob’s joy will break forth and Israel will be glad!

15.1: Yahweh, who dares to dwell with you? Who presumes the privilege of being close to you, living next to you in your shining place of glory?
15.2: They are passionate and wholehearted, always sincere and always speaking the truth— for their hearts are trustworthy.
15.3: They refuse to slander or insult others; they’ll never listen to gossip or rumors, nor would they ever harm a friend with their words.
15.4: They will despise evil and evil workers while commending the faithful ones who follow after the truth. They make firm commitments and follow through, even at great cost.
15.5: They never crush others with exploitation and they would never be bought with a bribe against the innocent. Those who do these things will never be shaken; they will stand firm forever.

16.1: Keep me safe, O mighty God. I run to you, my safe place.
16.2: I said to Yahweh, “You are my Maker and my Master. Any good thing you find in me has come from you.”
16.3: And he said to me, “My holy lovers in the land are my glorious ones, who fulfill all my desires.”
16.4: Yet there are those who yield to their weakness, and they will have troubles unending. I never gather with such ones, nor give them honor in any way.
16.5: Yahweh, you alone are my inheritance. You are my prize, my pleasure, and my portion. You hold my destiny and its timing in your hands.
16.6: Your pleasant path leads me to pleasant places. I’m overwhelmed by the privileges that come with following you!
16.7: The way you counsel me makes me praise you more, for your whispers in the night give me wisdom, showing me what to do next.
16.8: Because I set you, Yahweh, always close to me, my confidence will never be weakened, for I experience your wraparound presence every moment.
16.9: My heart and soul explode with joy—full of glory! Even my body will rest confident and secure.
16.10: For you will not abandon me to the realm of death, nor will you allow your Faithful One to experience corruption.
16.11: Because of you, I know the path of life, as I taste the fullness of joy in your presence. At your right side I experience divine pleasures forevermore!

17.1: Listen to me, Lord. Hear the passionate prayer of this honest man. My cause is just and my need is real. I’ve done what’s right and my lips speak truth.
17.2: Examine and exonerate me. Vindicate me and show the world I’m innocent.
17.3: For in a visitation of the night you inspected my heart and refined my soul in fire until nothing vile was found in me. I will not sin with my words.
17.4: Following your word has kept me from wrong. Your ways have molded my footsteps, keeping me from going down the paths of the violent.
17.5: My steps follow in the tracks of your chariot wheels, always staying in their path, never straying from your way.
17.6: You will answer me, God; I know you always will. Hear my words like you always do as you listen to my every prayer.
17.7: Magnify the marvels of your mercy to all who seek you. You are the loving Savior of all who turn aside to hide themselves in you.
17.8: Protect me from harm; keep an eye on me as you would a child who is reflected in the twinkling of your eye. Yes, hide me within the shelter of your embrace, under your outstretched wings.
17.9: Protect me there from all my foes. For there are many who surround my soul to completely destroy me.
17.10: They are pitiless, heartless—hard as nails, swollen with pride and filled with arrogance!
17.11: See how they close in on me, waiting for the chance to throw me to the ground.
17.12: They’re like lions eager to tear me apart, like young and fearless lions lurking in secret, so ferocious and cruel—ready to rip me to shreds.
17.13: Arise, God, and confront them! Challenge them with your might! Free me from their clutches and rescue me from their rage.
17.14: Throw them down to the ground, those who live for only this life on earth. Thrust them out of their prosperity and into their portion in eternity, leaving their wealth and wickedness behind!
17.15: As for me, because I am innocent, I will see your face until I see you for who you really are. I will be satisfied in an awakening of your likeness in me!

18.1: I love you, Yahweh, and I’m bonded to you, my strength!
18.2: Yahweh, you’re the bedrock beneath my feet, my faith-fortress, my wonderful deliverer, my God, my rock of rescue where none can reach me. You’re the shield around me, the mighty power that saves me, and my high place.
18.3: All I need to do is to call on you, Yahweh, the praiseworthy God. When I do, I’m safe and sound in you— delivered from my foes!
18.4: For when the cords of death wrapped around me and torrents of destruction overwhelmed me, taking me to death’s door,
18.5: The grave wrapped its ropes around me; death itself stared me in the face.
18.6: in my distress I cried out to you, the delivering God, and from your temple-throne you heard my troubled cry, and my sobs went right into your heart.
18.7: The earth itself shivered and shook. It reeled and rocked before him. As the mountains trembled, they melted away, for his anger was kindled on my behalf!
18.8: Fierce flames leapt from his mouth, erupting with blazing, burning coals as smoke and fire encircled him.
18.9: He stretched heaven’s curtain open and came to my defense. Swiftly he rode to earth as the stormy sky was lowered. He rode a chariot of thunderclouds amidst thick darkness; his steed was a cherub, soaring on outstretched wings of Spirit-Wind.
18.10: Mounted on a mighty angel, he flew, soaring on the wings of the wind.
18.11: Wrapped in the thick-cloud darkness, his thunder-tabernacle surrounded him. He hid himself in mystery-darkness; the dense rain clouds were his garments.
18.12: Suddenly the brilliance of his presence broke through with lightning bolts and hail— a tempest dropping coals of fire.
18.13: The Lord thundered; the great God above every god spoke with his thunder-voice from the sky. The Most High uttered his voice!
18.14: He released his lightning-arrows, and routed my foes. See how they ran and scattered in fear!
18.15: Then with his mighty roar he laid bare the foundations of the earth, uncovering the secret source of the sea. The hidden depths of land and sea were exposed by the blast of his hot breath.
18.16: He rescued me from the mighty waters and drew me to himself!
18.17: Even though I was helpless in the hands of my hateful, strong enemy, you were good to deliver me.
18.18: When I was at my weakest, my enemies attacked— but the Lord held on to me.
18.19: His love broke open the way, and he brought me into a beautiful, broad place. He rescued me—because his delight is in me!
18.20: He rewarded me for doing what’s right and staying pure.
18.21: I will follow his commands and I’ll not sin by ceasing to follow him, no matter what.
18.22: For I’ve kept my eyes focused on his righteous words, and I’ve obeyed everything that he’s told me to do.
18.23: I’ve been blameless before him and followed all his ways, keeping my heart pure.
18.24: And so Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, because I kept my heart clean before his eyes.
18.25: Good people will taste your goodness. And to those who are loyal to you, you love to prove that you are loyal and true.
18.26: And for those who are purified, they find you always pure. But you’ll outwit the crooked and cunning with your craftiness.
18.27: To the humble you bring heaven’s deliverance, but the proud and haughty you disregard.
18.28: God, all at once you turned on a floodlight for me! You are the revelation-light in my darkness, and in your brightness I can see the path ahead.
18.29: With you as my strength I can crush an enemy horde, advancing through every stronghold that stands in front of me.
18.30: Yahweh, what a perfect God you are! All Yahweh ’s promises have proven true. What a secure shelter for all those who turn to hide themselves in you, the wraparound God.
18.31: Could there be any other god like Yahweh? For there is not a more secure foundation than you.
18.32: God, you have wrapped me in power and made my way perfect.
18.33: Through you I ascend to the highest peaks to stand strong and secure in you.
18.34: You’ve trained me with the weapons of warfare-worship; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
18.35: You empower me for victory with your wraparound presence. Your power within makes me strong to subdue. By stooping down in gentleness, you made me great!
18.36: You’ve set me free, and now I’m standing complete, ready to fight some more!
18.37: I caught up with my enemies and conquered them and didn’t turn back until the war was won!
18.38: I smashed them to pieces and I finished them once and for all; they’re as good as dead.
18.39: You’ve placed your armor upon me and made my enemies bow low at my feet.
18.40: You’ve made them all turn tail and run, for through you I’ve destroyed them all!
18.41: They shouted for help, but no one dared to rescue them. They cried out to Yahweh, but he refused to answer them.
18.42: So I pulverized them to powder and cast them to the wind. I swept them away like dirt on the floor.
18.43: You gave me victory on every side, for you make me a leader of nations. Even those I’ve never heard of come and bow at my feet.
18.44: As soon as they heard of me they submitted to me. Even the rebel foreigners obey my every word.
18.45: Their rebellion fades away as they come near; trembling in their strongholds, they come crawling out of their hideouts, cringing in fear before me.
18.46: Yahweh lives! Praise is lifted high to the unshakable God! Towering over all, my Savior-God is worthy to be praised!
18.47: Look how he pays back harm to all who harm me, subduing all who come against me.
18.48: He rescues me from my enemies; he lifts me up high and keeps me out of reach, far from the grasp of my violent foe.
18.49: So I thank you, Yahweh, with my praises! I will sing my song to the highest God, so all among the nations will hear me.
18.50: You have given me, your king, great victories. You’ve always been tender and kind to me, your anointed one, your loving servant, David, and to all my descendants!

19.1: God’s splendor is a tale that is told, written in the stars. Space itself speaks his story through the marvels of the heavens. His truth is on tour in the starry vault of the sky, showing his skill in creation’s craftsmanship.
19.2: Each day gushes out its message to the next, night by night whispering its knowledge to all—
19.3: without a sound, without a word, without a voice being heard,
19.4: yet all the world can hear its echo. Everywhere its message goes out. What a heavenly home God has set for the sun, shining in the superdome of the sky!
19.5: See how he leaves his celestial chamber each morning, radiant as a bridegroom ready for his wedding, like a day-breaking champion eager to run his course.
19.6: He rises on one horizon, completing his circuit on the other, warming lives and lands with his heat.
19.7: Yahweh ’s Word is perfect in every way; how it revives our souls! Yahweh ’s laws lead us to truth, and his ways change the simple into wise.
19.8: Yahweh ’s teachings are right and make us joyful; his precepts are so pure! Yahweh ’s commands challenge us to keep close to his heart! The revelation-light of his Word makes my spirit shine radiant.
19.9: Yahweh ’s decrees are trustworthy. The fear of Yahweh is pure, enduring forever.
19.10: The rarest treasures of life are found in his truth. That’s why God’s Word is prized like others prize the finest gold. Sweeter also than honey are his living words— sweet words dripping from the honeycomb!
19.11: For they warn us, your servants, and keep us from following the wicked way, giving a lifetime guarantee: great success to every obedient soul!
19.12: How would I discern the waywardness of my heart? Lord, forgive my hidden flaws whenever you find them.
19.13: Keep cleansing me, God, and keep me from my secret, selfish sins; may they never rule over me! For only then will I be free from fault and remain innocent of rebellion.
19.14: So may the words of my mouth, my meditation-thoughts, and every movement of my heart be always pure and pleasing, acceptable before your eyes, Yahweh, my only Redeemer, my Protector.

20.1: In your day of danger may Yahweh answer and deliver you. May the name of the God of Jacob set you safely on high!
20.2: May supernatural help be sent from his sanctuary. May he support you from Zion’s fortress!
20.3: May he remember every gift you have given him and celebrate every sacrifice of love you have shown him.
20.4: May Yahweh give you every desire of your heart and carry out your every plan as you go to battle.
20.5: When you succeed, we will celebrate and shout for joy. Flags will fly when victory is yours! Yes, God will answer your prayers, and we will praise him!
20.6: I know Yahweh gives me all that I ask for and brings victory to his anointed king. My deliverance cry will be heard in his holy heaven. By his mighty hand miracles will manifest through his saving strength.
20.7: Some find their strength in their weapons and wisdom, but my miracle-deliverance can never be won by men. Our boast is in Yahweh our God, who makes us strong and gives us victory!
20.8: Our enemies will not prevail; they will only collapse and perish in defeat while we will rise up, full of courage.
20.9: Give victory to our king, O Yahweh! The day we call on you, give us your answer!

21.1: Yahweh, because of your strength the king is strong. Look how he rejoices in you! He bursts out with a joyful song because of your victory!
21.2: For you have given him his heart’s desire, anything and everything he asks for. You haven’t withheld a thing from the king.
21.3: Rich blessings overflow with every encounter with you, and you placed a royal crown of gold upon his head.
21.4: He wanted life —you have given it to him and more! The days of his blessing stretch on one after another, forever!
21.5: You have honored him and made him famous. Glory-garments are upon him, and you surround him with splendor and majesty.
21.6: Your victory heaps blessing after blessing upon him. What joy and bliss he tastes, rejoicing before your face!
21.7: For the king trusts in Yahweh, and he will never stumble, never fall. The forever-love of the Most High holds him firm.
21.8: Your almighty hands have captured your foes. You uncovered all who hate you and you seized them.
21.9: When you appear before them, unveiling the radiance of your face, they will be consumed by the fierce fire of your presence. Yahweh ’s flames will swallow them up. They and their descendants will be destroyed by an unrelenting fire.
21.10: You will wipe their children from the face of the earth; they will never have descendants.
21.11: We will watch them fail, for these are the ones who plan their evil schemes against the Lord.
21.12: They will turn and run at the sight of your judgment-arrows aimed straight at their hearts.
21.13: Rise up and put your might on display! By your strength we will sing and praise your glorious power!

22.1: God, my God! Why would you abandon me now?
22.2: Why do you remain distant, refusing to answer my tearful cries in the day and my desperate cries for your help in the night? I can’t stop sobbing. Where are you, my God?
22.3: Yet I know that you are most holy. You are God-Enthroned, the praise of Israel.
22.4: Our fathers’ faith was in you— through the generations they trusted in you and you came through.
22.5: Every time they cried out to you in their despair, you were faithful to deliver them; you didn’t disappoint them.
22.6: But I am like a worm, crushed and bleeding crimson, treated as less than human. I’ve been despised and scorned by everyone!
22.7: Mocked by their jeers, despised with their sneers, as all the people poke fun at me, spitting their insults,
22.8: saying, “Is this the one who trusted in God? Now let’s see if Yahweh will come to your rescue! Let’s see how much he delights in him!”
22.9: Lord, you delivered me safely from my mother’s womb. You are the one who cared for me ever since I was a baby.
22.10: Since the day I was born, I’ve been placed in your custody. You’ve cradled me throughout my days, and you’ve always been my God.
22.11: So don’t leave me now, for trouble is all around me, and there’s no one to help me.
22.12: I’m surrounded by many violent foes like bulls; forces of evil encircle me like the strong bulls of Bashan.
22.13: Like ravenous, roaring lions tearing their prey, they pour curses from their mouths.
22.14: Now I’m completely exhausted. Every joint of my body has been pulled apart. My courage has melted away.
22.15: I’m so thirsty and parched. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. And now you lay me in the dust of death.
22.16: They have pierced my hands and my feet. Like a pack of wild dogs they tear at me, swirling around me with their hatred. A band of evil men surrounds me.
22.17: I can count all my bones. Look at how they gloat over me and stare!
22.18: With a toss of the dice they divide my clothes among themselves, gambling for my garments!
22.19: Yahweh, please don’t stay far away. My strength, come quickly to my rescue.
22.20: Give me back my life. Save me from this violent death. Save my precious one and only from the power of these dogs!
22.21: Save me from all the power of the enemy, from this roaring lion raging against me and the power of his dark horde.
22.22: I will declare your name before all my brothers and praise you in the midst of the congregation.
22.23: Those who fear Yahweh, praise him! Let all the seed of Jacob glorify him with your praises. Stand in awe of him, all you offspring of Israel!
22.24: For he has not despised my cries of deep despair. He’s my first responder to my sufferings, and when I was in pain, he was there all the time and heard the cries of the afflicted.
22.25: You’re the reason for my praise; it comes from you and goes to you. I will keep my promise to praise you before all who fear you among the congregation of your people.
22.26: Let all the poor and broken eat until satisfied. Bring Yahweh praise and you will find him. May your hearts overflow with life forever!
22.27: From the four corners of the earth, the peoples of the world will remember and return to Yahweh. Every nation will come and worship him.
22.28: For Yahweh is King of all, who takes charge of all the nations.
22.29: The wealthy of this world will feast in fellowship with him right alongside the humble of heart, bowing down to the dust, forsaking their own souls. They will all come and worship this worthy King!
22.30: His spiritual seed shall serve him. Future generations will hear from us about the wonders of the Victorious Lord.
22.31: His generation yet to be born will glorify him. And they will all declare, “It is finished!”

23.1: Yahweh is my best friend and my shepherd. I always have more than enough.
23.2: He offers a resting place for me in his luxurious love. His tracks take me to an oasis of peace near the quiet brook of bliss.
23.3: That’s where he restores and revives my life. He opens before me the right path and leads me along in his footsteps of righteousness so that I can bring honor to his name.
23.4: Even when your path takes me through the valley of deepest darkness, fear will never conquer me, for you already have! Your authority is my strength and my peace. The comfort of your love takes away my fear. I’ll never be lonely, for you are near.
23.5: You become my delicious feast even when my enemies dare to fight. You anoint me with the fragrance of your Holy Spirit; you give me all I can drink of you until my cup overflows.
23.6: So why would I fear the future? Only goodness and tender love pursue me all the days of my life. Then afterward, when my life is through, I’ll return to your glorious presence to be forever with you!

24.1: Yahweh claims the world as his. Everything and everyone belong to him!
24.2: He’s the one who pushed back oceans to let the dry ground appear, planting firm foundations for the earth.
24.3: Who, then, is allowed to ascend the mountain of Yahweh? And who has the privilege of entering into God’s Holy Place?
24.4: Those who are clean—whose works and ways are pure, whose hearts are true and sealed by the truth, those who never deceive, whose words are sure.
24.5: They will receive Yahweh ’s blessing and righteousness given by the Savior-God.
24.6: They will stand before God, for they seek the pleasure of God’s face, the God of Jacob.
24.7: So wake up, you living gateways! Lift up your heads, you doorways of eternity! Welcome the King of Glory, for he is about to come through you.
24.8: You ask, “Who is this King of Glory?” Yahweh, armed and ready for battle, Yahweh, invincible in every way!
24.9: So wake up, you living gateways, and rejoice! Fling wide, you eternal doors! Here he comes; the King of Glory is ready to come in.
24.10: You ask, “Who is this King of Glory?” He is Yahweh, armed and ready for battle, the Mighty One, the invincible commander of heaven’s hosts! Yes, he is the King of Glory!

25.1: Always I will lift up my soul into your presence, Yahweh.
25.2: Be there for me, my God, for I keep trusting in you. Don’t allow my foes to gloat over me or the shame of defeat to overtake me.
25.3: Could anyone be disgraced when he has entwined his heart with yours? But my foes will all be defeated and ashamed when they harm the innocent.
25.4: Direct me, Yahweh, throughout my journey so I can experience your plans for my life. Reveal the life-paths that are pleasing to you.
25.5: Escort me into your truth; take me by the hand and teach me. For you are the God of my salvation; I have wrapped my heart into yours all day long!
25.6: Forgive my failures as a young man, and overlook the sins of my immaturity. Give me grace, Yahweh! Always look at me through your eyes of love— your forgiving eyes of mercy and compassion. When you think of me, see me as one you love and care for.
25.7: Forgive the rebellious sins of my youth; look instead through the eyes of your unfailing love, for you are merciful, O LORD.
25.8: How good you are to me! When people turn to you, Yahweh, they discover how easy you are to please—so faithful and true! Joyfully you teach them the proper path, even when they go astray.
25.9: Keep showing the humble your path, and lead them into the best decision. Bring revelation-light that trains them in the truth.
25.10: Loving are all the ways of Yahweh, loving and faithful for those who keep his covenant.
25.11: For the honor of your name, Yahweh, never count my many sins, and forgive them all— lift their burden off of my life!
25.12: Who are they that live in the holy fear of Yahweh? You will show them the right path to take.
25.13: Then prosperity and favor will be their portion, and their descendants will inherit the earth.
25.14: There’s a private place reserved for the devoted lovers of Yahweh, where they sit near him and receive the revelation-secrets of his promises.
25.15: Rescue me, Yahweh, for you free my feet from every trap.
25.16: Sorrows fill my heart as I feel helpless, mistreated— I’m all alone and in misery! Come closer to me now, for I need your mercy.
25.17: Turn to me, for my problems seem to be going from bad to worse. Only you can free me from all these troubles!
25.18: Until you lift this burden, the burden of all my sins, my troubles and trials will be more than I can handle. Can’t you feel my pain?
25.19: Vicious, violent enemies hate me. There are so many, Lord. Can’t you see?
25.20: Will you protect me from their power against me? I have taken shelter in you. Let it never be said that when I trusted you, you didn’t come to my rescue.
25.21: Your perfection and faithfulness are my bodyguards, for you are my hope and I trust in you as my only protection.
25.22: Zealously, God, we ask you to come save Israel from all her troubles, for you provide the ransom price for your people!

26.1: Yahweh, be my judge and declare me innocent! Clear my name, for I walk in integrity and trust you without wavering.
26.2: Yahweh, you can scrutinize me. Refine my heart and probe my every thought. Put me to the test and you’ll find me true.
26.3: I will never lose sight of your steadfast love for me. Your faithfulness has steadied my steps.
26.4: I won’t keep company with tricky, two-faced men, nor will I go the way of those with hidden motives.
26.5: I despise the sinner’s hangouts. You won’t find me walking with the wicked.
26.6: When I come to your altar, Yahweh, I’ll be clean before you, approaching with songs of thanksgiving, singing songs of your mighty miracles.
26.7: singing a song of thanksgiving and telling of all your miracles.
26.8: Yahweh, I love to live in your house, this dwelling place of dazzling glory!
26.9: Don’t treat me as one of these scheming sinners who plot violence against the innocent.
26.10: Look how they devise their wicked plans; their hands are always ready to receive a bribe.
26.11: I’m not like them, Lord—not at all. Save me, redeem me with your mercy, for I have chosen to walk only in what is right.
26.12: Among the worshipers I will praise Yahweh, for I am safe and secure because of you!

27.1: Yahweh is my revelation-light and the source of my salvation. I fear no one! I’ll never turn back and run, for you, Yahweh, surround and protect me.
27.2: When evil ones come to destroy me, they will be the ones who turn back.
27.3: My heart will not fear even if an army rises to attack. I will not be shaken, even if war is imminent.
27.4: Here’s the one thing I crave from Yahweh, the one thing I seek above all else: I want to live with him every moment in his house, beholding the marvelous beauty of Yahweh, filled with awe, delighting in his glory and grace. I want to contemplate in his temple.
27.5: In the day of trouble, he will treasure me in his shelter, under the cover of his tent. He will lift me high upon a rock, out of reach from all my enemies who surround me. Triumphant now, I’ll bring him my offerings of praise, singing and shouting with ecstatic joy! Yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh!
27.6: Then I will hold my head high, above my enemies who surround me. At his Tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy, singing and praising the LORD with music.
27.7: Hear my cry. Show me mercy, and send the help I need!
27.8: I heard your voice in my heart say, “Come, seek my face;” my inner being responded, “ Yahweh, I’m seeking your face with all my heart.”
27.9: So don’t turn your face away from me. You’re the God of my salvation; how can you reject your servant in anger? You’ve been my only hope, so don’t forsake me now when I need you!
27.10: My father and mother abandoned me. But you, Yahweh, took me in and made me yours.
27.11: Now teach me, Yahweh, all about your ways and tell me what to do. Make it clear for me to understand, for I am surrounded by waiting enemies.
27.12: Don’t let them defeat me, Lord. You can’t let me fall into their clutches! They keep accusing me of things I’ve never done, breathing out violence against me.
27.13: Yet I believe with all my heart that I will see again your goodness, Yahweh, in the land of life eternal!
27.14: Here’s what I’ve learned through it all: Don’t give up; don’t be impatient; be entwined as one with the Lord. Be brave and courageous, and never lose hope. Yes, keep on waiting— for he will never disappoint you!

28.1: I’m pleading with you, Yahweh, help me! Don’t close your ears to my cry, for you’re my defender. If you continue to remain aloof and refuse to answer me, I might as well give up and die.
28.2: Hear my cry for help as I turn toward your mercy seat, as I lift my hands toward your sacred sanctuary.
28.3: Don’t allow me to be punished along with the wicked— these hypocrites who speak sweetly to their neighbors’ faces while holding evil against them in their hearts.
28.4: Go ahead and punish them as they deserve. Let them be paid back for all their evil plans in proportion to their wickedness.
28.5: Since they don’t care anything about you, or understand the great things you’ve done, take them down like an old building being demolished, never again to be rebuilt.
28.6: But Yahweh, may your name be blessed and built up! For you have answered my passionate cry for mercy.
28.7: Yahweh is my strength and my wraparound shield. When I fully trust in you, help is on the way. I jump for joy and burst forth with ecstatic, passionate praise! I will sing songs of what you mean to me!
28.8: You will be the inner strength of all your people, Yahweh, the mighty protector of all, and the saving strength for all your anointed ones.
28.9: Save your people whom you love, and bless your chosen ones. Be our shepherd leading us forward, forever carrying us in your arms!

29.1: Proclaim his majesty, all you mighty sons of Yahweh, giving all the glory and strength back to him!
29.2: Be in awe before his majesty. Be in awe before such power and might! Come worship wonderful Yahweh, arrayed in all his splendor, bowing in worship as he appears in the beauty of holiness. Give him the honor due his name. Worship him wearing the glory-garments of your holy, priestly calling!
29.3: The voice of the Lord echoes through the skies and seas. The Glory-God reigns as he thunders in the clouds. So powerful is his voice, so brilliant and bright— how majestic as he thunders over the great waters!
29.4: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
29.5: His tympanic thunder topples the strongest of trees. His symphonic sound splinters the mighty forests.
29.6: Now he moves Zion’s mountains by the might of his voice, shaking the snowy peaks with his earsplitting sound!
29.7: The lightning-fire flashes, striking as he speaks.
29.8: God reveals himself when he makes the fault lines quake, shaking deserts, speaking his voice.
29.9: God’s mighty voice makes the deer to give birth. His thunderbolt-voice lays the forest bare. In his temple all fall before him with each one shouting, “Glory, glory, the God of glory!”
29.10: Above the furious flood, the Enthroned One reigns, the King-God rules with eternity at his side.
29.11: This is the one who gives his strength and might to his people. This is the Lord giving us his kiss of peace.

30.1: Lord, I will exalt you and lift you high, for you have lifted me up on high! Over all my boasting, gloating enemies, you made me to triumph.
30.2: O Lord, my healing God, I cried out for a miracle and you healed me!
30.3: You brought me back from the brink of death, from the depths below. Now here I am, alive and well, fully restored!
30.4: O sing and make melody, you steadfast lovers of God. Give thanks to him every time you reflect on his holiness!
30.5: I’ve learned that his anger lasts for a moment, but his loving favor lasts a lifetime! We may weep through the night, but at daybreak it will turn into shouts of ecstatic joy.
30.6: I remember boasting, “I’ve got it made! Nothing can stop me now! I’m God’s favored one; he’s made me steady as a mountain!” But then suddenly, you hid your face from me. I was panic-stricken and became depressed.
30.7: Your favor, O LORD, made me as secure as a mountain. Then you turned away from me, and I was shattered.
30.8: Still I cried out to you, Lord God. I shouted out for mercy, saying,
30.9: “What would you gain in my death, if I were to go down to the depths of darkness? Will a grave sing your song? How could death’s dust declare your faithfulness?”
30.10: So hear me now, Lord; show me your famous mercy. O God, be my Savior and rescue me!
30.11: Then he broke through and transformed all my wailing into a whirling dance of ecstatic praise! He has torn the veil and lifted from me the sad heaviness of mourning. He wrapped me in the glory-garments of gladness.
30.12: How could I be silent when it’s time to praise you? Now my heart sings out, bursting with joy— a bliss inside that keeps me singing, “I can never thank you enough!”

31.1: I trust you, Lord, to be my hiding place. Don’t let me down. Don’t let my enemies bring me to shame. Come and rescue me, for you are the only God who always does what is right.
31.2: Rescue me quickly when I cry out to you. At the sound of my prayer may your ear be turned to me. Be my strong shelter and hiding place on high. Pull me into victory and breakthrough.
31.3: For you are my high fortress, where I’m kept safe. You are to me a stronghold of salvation. When you deliver me out of this peril, it will bring glory to your name. As you guide me forth I’ll be kept safe from the hidden snares of the enemy— the secret traps that lie before me— for you have become my rock of strength.
31.4: Pull me from the trap my enemies set for me, for I find protection in you alone.
31.5: Into your hands I now entrust my spirit. O Lord, the God of faithfulness, you have rescued and redeemed me.
31.6: I despise these deceptive illusions, all this pretense and nonsense, for I worship only you.
31.7: In mercy you have seen my troubles, and you have cared for me; even during this crisis in my soul I will be radiant with joy, filled with praise for your love and mercy.
31.8: You have kept me from being conquered by my enemy; you broke open the way to bring me to freedom, into a beautiful, broad place.
31.9: O Lord, help me again! Keep showing me such mercy. For I am in anguish, always in tears, and I’m worn out with weeping. I’m becoming old because of grief; my health is broken.
31.10: I’m exhausted! My life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing and sadness. Because of all these troubles, I have no more strength. My inner being is so weak and frail.
31.11: My enemies say, “You are nothing!” Even my friends and neighbors hold me in contempt! They dread seeing me, and they look the other way when I pass by.
31.12: I am totally forgotten, buried away like a dead man, discarded like a broken dish thrown in the trash.
31.13: I overheard their whispered threats, the slander of my enemies. I’m terrified as they plot and scheme to take my life.
31.14: I’m desperate, Lord! I throw myself upon you, for you alone are my God!
31.15: My life, my every moment, my destiny—it’s all in your hands. So I know you can deliver me from those who persecute me relentlessly.
31.16: Smile on me, your servant. Let your undying love and glorious grace save me from all this gloom.
31.17: As I call upon you, let my shame and disgrace be replaced by your favor once again. But let shame and disgrace fall instead upon the wicked— those going to their own doom, drifting down in silence to the dust of death.
31.18: At last their lying lips will be muted in their graves. For they are arrogant, filled with contempt and conceit as they speak against the godly.
31.19: Lord, how wonderful you are! You have stored up so many good things for us, like a treasure chest heaped up and spilling over with blessings— all for those who honor and worship you! Everybody knows what you can do for those who turn and hide themselves in you.
31.20: So hide all your beloved ones in the sheltered, secret place before your face. Overshadow them with your glory-presence. Keep them from these accusations, the brutal insults of evil men. Tuck them safely away in the tabernacle where you dwell.
31.21: The name of the Lord is blessed and lifted high! For his marvelous miracle of mercy protected me when I was overwhelmed by my enemies.
31.22: I spoke hastily when I said, “The Lord has deserted me.” For in truth, you did hear my prayer and came to rescue me.
31.23: Listen to me, all you godly ones: Love the Lord with passion! The Lord protects and preserves all those who are loyal to him. But he pays back in full all those who reject him in their pride.
31.24: So cheer up! Take courage, all you who love him. Wait for him to break through for you, all who trust in him!

32.1: What bliss belongs to the one whose rebellion has been forgiven, those whose sins are covered by blood.
32.2: What bliss belongs to those who have confessed their corruption to God! For he wipes their slates clean and removes hypocrisy from their hearts.
32.3: Before I confessed my sins, I kept it all inside; my dishonesty devastated my inner life, causing my life to be filled with frustration, irrepressible anguish, and misery.
32.4: The pain never let up, for your hand of conviction was heavy on my heart. My strength was sapped, my inner life dried up like a spiritual drought within my soul.
32.5: Then I finally admitted to you all my sins, refusing to hide them any longer. I said, “My life-giving God, I will openly acknowledge my evil actions.” And you forgave me! All at once the guilt of my sin washed away and all my pain disappeared!
32.6: This is what I’ve learned through it all: All believers should confess their sins to God; do it every time God has uncovered you in the time of exposing. For if you do this, when sudden storms of life overwhelm, you’ll be kept safe.
32.7: Lord, you are my secret hiding place, protecting me from these troubles, surrounding me with songs of gladness! Your joyous shouts of rescue release my breakthrough.
32.8: I hear the Lord saying, “I will stay close to you, instructing and guiding you along the pathway for your life. I will advise you along the way and lead you forth with my eyes as your guide. So don’t make it difficult; don’t be stubborn when I take you where you’ve not been before. Don’t make me tug you and pull you along. Just come with me!”
32.9: Do not be like a senseless horse or mule that needs a bit and bridle to keep it under control."
32.10: So my conclusion is this: Many are the sorrows and frustrations of those who don’t come clean with God. But when you trust in the Lord for forgiveness, his wraparound love will surround you.
32.11: So celebrate the goodness of God! He shows this kindness to everyone who is his. Go ahead—shout for joy, all you upright ones who want to please him!

33.1: It’s time to sing and shout for joy! Go ahead, all you redeemed ones, do it! Praise him with all you have, for praise looks lovely on the lips of God’s devoted lovers.
33.2: Play the guitar as you lift your praises loaded with thanksgiving. Sing and make joyous music with all you’ve got inside.
33.3: Compose new melodies that release new praises to the Lord. Play his praises on instruments with the anointing and skill he gives you. Sing and shout with passion; make a spectacular sound of joy—
33.4: For God’s Word is something to sing about! He is true to his promises, his word can be trusted, and everything he does is reliable and right.
33.5: The Lord loves seeing justice on the earth. Anywhere and everywhere you can find his faithful, unfailing love!
33.6: All he had to do was speak by his Spirit-Wind command, and God created the heavenlies. Filled with galaxies and stars, the vast cosmos he wonderfully made.
33.7: His voice scooped out the seas. The ocean depths he poured into vast reservoirs.
33.8: With breathtaking wonder, let everyone worship Yahweh, this awe-inspiring Creator.
33.9: He breathed words and worlds were birthed. “Let there be,” and there it was— springing forth the moment he spoke, no sooner said than done!
33.10: With his breath he scatters the schemes of nations who oppose him; they will never succeed.
33.11: His destiny-plan for the earth stands sure. His forever-plan remains in place and will never fail.
33.12: Blessed and prosperous is that nation who has God as their Lord! They will be the people he has chosen for his own.
33.13: The Lord looks over us from where he rules in heaven. Gazing into every heart from his lofty dwelling place, he observes all the peoples of the earth. The Creator of our hearts considers and examines everything we do.
33.14: From his throne he observes all who live on the earth.
33.15: He made their hearts, so he understands everything they do.
33.16: Even if a king had the best-equipped army, it would never be enough to save him. Even if the best warrior went to battle, he could not be saved simply by his strength alone.
33.17: Human strength and the weapons of man are false hopes for victory; they may seem mighty, but they will always disappoint.
33.18: The eyes of the Lord are upon even the weakest worshipers who love him— those who wait in hope and expectation for the strong, steady love of God.
33.19: God will deliver them from death, even the certain death of famine, with no one to help.
33.20: The Lord alone is our radiant hope and we trust in him with all our hearts. His wraparound presence will strengthen us.
33.21: As we trust, we rejoice with an uncontained joy flowing from Yahweh!
33.22: Let your love and steadfast kindness overshadow us continually, for we trust and we wait upon you!

34.1: Lord! I’m bursting with joy over what you’ve done for me! My lips are full of perpetual praise.
