34.2: I’m boasting of you and all your works, so let all who are discouraged take heart.
34.3: Join me, everyone! Let’s praise the Lord together. Let’s make him famous! Let’s make his name glorious to all.
34.4: Listen to my testimony: I cried to God in my distress and he answered me. He freed me from all my fears!
34.5: Gaze upon him, join your life with his, and joy will come. Your faces will glisten with glory. You’ll never wear that shame-face again.
34.6: When I had nothing, desperate and defeated, I cried out to the Lord and he heard me, bringing his miracle-deliverance when I needed it most.
34.7: The angel of Yahweh stooped down to listen as I prayed, encircling me, empowering me, and showing me how to escape. He will do this for everyone who fears God.
34.8: Drink deeply of the pleasures of this God. Experience for yourself the joyous mercies he gives to all who turn to hide themselves in him.
34.9: Worship in awe and wonder, all you who’ve been made holy! For all who fear him will feast with plenty.
34.10: Even the strong and the wealthy grow weak and hungry, but those who passionately pursue the Lord will never lack any good thing.
34.11: Come, children of God, and listen to me. I’ll share the lesson I’ve learned of fearing the Lord:
34.12: Do you want to live a long, good life, enjoying the beauty that fills each day? Then never speak a lie or allow wicked words to come from your mouth.
34.13: Then watch your tongue! Keep your lips from telling lies!
34.14: Keep turning your back on every sin, and make “peace” your life motto. Practice being at peace with everyone.
34.15: The Lord sees all we do; he watches over his friends day and night. His godly ones receive the answers they seek whenever they cry out to him.
34.16: But the Lord has made up his mind to oppose evildoers and to wipe out even the memory of them from the face of the earth.
34.17: Yet when holy lovers of God cry out to him with all their hearts, the Lord will hear them and come to rescue them from all their troubles.
34.18: The Lord is close to all whose hearts are crushed by pain, and he is always ready to restore the repentant one.
34.19: Even when bad things happen to the good and godly ones, the Lord will save them and not let them be defeated by what they face.
34.20: God will be your bodyguard to protect you when trouble is near. Not one bone will be broken.
34.21: Evil will cause the death of the wicked, for they hate and persecute the devoted lovers of God. Make no mistake about it: God will hold them guilty and punish them; they will pay the penalty!
34.22: But the Lord has paid for the freedom of his servants, and he will freely pardon those who love him. He will declare them free and innocent when they turn to hide themselves in him.

35.1: O Lord, fight for me! Harass the hecklers; accuse my accusers. Fight those who fight against me.
35.2: Put on your armor, Lord; take up your shield and protect me. Rise up, mighty God! Grab your weapons of war and block the way of the wicked who come to fight me. Stand for me when they stand against me! Speak over my soul: “I am your strong Savior!”
35.3: Lift up your spear and javelin and block the way of my enemies. Let me hear you say, "I am your salvation!"
35.4: Humiliate those who seek my harm. Defeat them all! Frustrate their plans to defeat me and drive them back. Disgrace them all as they have devised their plans to disgrace me.
35.5: Blow them away like dust in the wind, with the angel of Almighty God driving them back!
35.6: Make the road in front of them nothing but slippery darkness, with the angel of Yahweh behind them, chasing them away!
35.7: For though I did nothing wrong to them, they set a trap for me, wanting me to fail and fall.
35.8: Surprise them with your ambush, Lord, and catch them in the very trap they set for me. Let them be the ones to fail and fall into destruction!
35.9: Then my fears will dissolve into limitless joy; my whole being will overflow with gladness because of your mighty deliverance.
35.10: Everything inside of me will shout it out: “There’s no one like you, Lord!” For look at how you protect the weak and helpless from the strong and heartless who oppress them.
35.11: They are malicious men, hostile witnesses of wrong. They rise up against me, accusers appearing out of nowhere.
35.12: When I show them mercy, they bring me misery. I’m forsaken and forlorn, like a motherless child.
35.13: I even prayed over them when they were sick. I was burdened and bowed low with fasting and interceded for their healing, and I didn’t stop praying.
35.14: I grieved for them, heavyhearted, as though they were my dearest family members or my good friends who were sick, nearing death, needing prayer.
35.15: But when I was the one who tripped up and stumbled, they came together to slander me, rejoicing in my time of trouble, tearing me to shreds with their lies and betrayal.
35.16: These nameless ruffians, mocking me like godless fools at a feast— how they delight in throwing mud on my name.
35.17: God, how long can you just stand there doing nothing? Now is the time to act. Rescue me from these brutal men, for I am being torn to shreds by these beasts who are out to get me. Save me from their rage, their cruel grasp.
35.18: Then I will praise you wherever I go. And when everyone gathers for worship, I will lift up your praise with a shout in front of the largest crowd I can find!
35.19: Don’t let those who fight me for no reason be victorious. Don’t let them succeed, these heartless haters who come against me with their gloating sneers.
35.20: They are the ones who would never seek peace as friends, for they are ever devising deceit against the innocent ones who mind their own business.
35.21: They open their mouths with ugly grins, gloating with glee over my every fault. “Look,” they say, “we caught him red-handed! We saw him fall with our own eyes!”
35.22: Yahweh, my caring God, you have been there all along. You have seen their hypocrisy. Yahweh, don’t let them get away with this. Don’t walk away without doing something.
35.23: Now is the time to awake! Rise up, Lord! Vindicate me, my Lord and my God!
35.24: You have every right to judge me, Lord, according to your righteousness, but don’t let them rejoice over me when I stumble.
35.25: Let them all be ashamed of themselves, humiliated when they rejoice over my every blunder. Shame them, Lord, when they say, “We saw what he did. Now we have him right where we want him. Let’s get him while he’s down!” Make them look ridiculous when they exalt themselves over me. May they all be disgraced and dishonored!
35.26: May those who rejoice at my troubles be humiliated and disgraced. May those who triumph over me be covered with shame and dishonor.
35.27: But let all my true friends shout for joy, all those who know and love what I do for you. Let them all say, “The Lord is great, and he delights in the prosperity of his servant.”
35.28: Then I won’t be able to hold it in— everyone will hear my joyous praises all day long! Your righteousness will be the theme of my glory-song of praise!

36.1: The rebellion of sin speaks as an oracle of God, speaking deeply to the conscience of wicked men. Yet they are still eager to sin, for the fear of God is not before their eyes.
36.2: See how they flatter themselves, unable to detect and detest their sins. They are crooked and conceited, convinced they can get away with anything.
36.3: Their wicked words are nothing but lies. Wisdom is far from them. Goodness is both forgotten and forsaken.
36.4: They lie awake at night to hatch their evil plots, always planning their schemes of darkness, and never once do they consider the evil of their ways.
36.5: But you, O Lord, your mercy-seat love is limitless, reaching higher than the highest heavens. Your great faithfulness is infinite, stretching over the whole earth.
36.6: Your righteousness is unmovable, just like the mighty mountains. Your judgments are as full of wisdom as the oceans are full of water. Your tender care and kindness leave no one forgotten, not a man or even a mouse.
36.7: O God, how extravagant is your cherishing love! All mankind can find a hiding place under the shadow of your wings.
36.8: All may drink of the anointing from the abundance of your house. All may drink their fill from the rivers of Eden.
36.9: The fountain of life flows from you to satisfy me. In your light of holiness we receive the light of revelation.
36.10: Lord, keep pouring out your unfailing love on those who are near you. Release more of your blessings to those who are loyal to you.
36.11: Don’t let these proud boasters trample me down; don’t let them push me around by the sheer strength of their wickedness.
36.12: There they lie in the dirt, these evil ones, thrown down to the ground, never to arise again!

37.1: Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you.
37.2: They and their short-lived success will soon shrivel up and quickly fade away, like grass clippings in the hot sun.
37.3: Keep trusting in the Lord and do what is right in his eyes. Fix your heart on the promises of God, and you will dwell in the land, feasting on his faithfulness.
37.4: Find your delight and true pleasure in Yahweh, and he will give you what you desire the most.
37.5: Give God the right to direct your life, and as you trust him along the way, you’ll find he pulled it off perfectly!
37.6: He will appear as your righteousness, as sure as the dawning of a new day. He will manifest as your justice, as sure and strong as the noonday sun.
37.7: Quiet your heart in his presence and wait patiently for Yahweh. And don’t think for a moment that the wicked, in their prosperity, are better off than you.
37.8: Stay away from anger and revenge. Keep envy far from you, for it only leads you into lies.
37.9: For one day the wicked will be destroyed, but those who trust in the Lord will inherit the land.
37.10: Just a little while longer and the ungodly will vanish; you will look for them in vain.
37.11: But the humble of heart will inherit every promise and enjoy abundant peace.
37.12: Let the wicked keep plotting against the godly with all their sneers and arrogant jeers.
37.13: God laughs at the wicked and their plans, for he knows their day is coming!
37.14: Evil ones take aim at the poor and helpless; they are ready to slaughter those who do right.
37.15: But the Lord will turn all their weapons of wickedness back on themselves, piercing their pride-filled hearts until they are helpless.
37.16: It is much better to have little combined with much of God than to have the fabulous wealth of the wicked and nothing else.
37.17: For the Lord takes care of all his forgiven ones while the strength of evil men will surely slip away.
37.18: Day by day the Lord watches the good deeds of the godly, and he prepares for them his forever-reward.
37.19: Even in a time of disaster he will watch over them, and they will always have more than enough no matter what happens.
37.20: All the enemies of God will perish. For the wicked have only a momentary value, a fading glory. Then one day they vanish! Here today, gone tomorrow.
37.21: They break their promises, borrowing money but never paying it back. The good man returns what he owes with some extra besides.
37.22: Yahweh ’s blessed ones receive the land, but the cursed ones will be cut off with nothing to show for themselves.
37.23: When Yahweh delights in how you live your life, he establishes your every step.
37.24: If they stumble badly they will still survive, for the Lord lifts them up with his hands.
37.25: I was once inexperienced, but now I’m old. Not once have I found a lover of God forsaken by him, nor have any of their children gone hungry.
37.26: Instead, I’ve found the godly ones to be the generous ones who give freely to others. Their children are blessed and become a blessing.
37.27: If you truly want to dwell forever in God’s presence, forsake evil and do what is right in his eyes.
37.28: The Lord loves it when he sees us walking in his justice. He will never desert his devoted lovers; they will be kept forever in his faithful care, but the descendants of the wicked will be banished.
37.29: The faithful lovers of God will inherit the earth and enjoy every promise of God’s care, dwelling in peace forever.
37.30: God-lovers make the best counselors. Their words possess wisdom and are right and trustworthy.
37.31: The ways of God are in their hearts and they won’t swerve from the paths of steadfast righteousness.
37.32: Evil ones spy on the godly ones, stalking them to find something they could use to accuse them. They’re out for the kill!
37.33: But God will foil all their plots. The godly will not stand condemned when brought to trial.
37.34: So don’t be impatient for Yahweh to act; keep moving forward steadily in his ways, and he will exalt you to possess the land. You’ll watch with your own eyes and see the wicked lose everything.
37.35: I’ve already seen this happen. Once I saw a wicked and violent man overpower all who were around him, a domineering tyrant with his prideful and oppressive ways.
37.36: Then he died and was forgotten. Now no one cares that he is gone forever.
37.37: But you can tell who are the blameless and spiritually mature. What a different story with them! The godly ones will have a peaceful, prosperous future with a happy ending.
37.38: Every evil sinner will be destroyed, obliterated. They’ll be utter failures with no future!
37.39: But the Lord will be the Savior of all who love him. Even in their time of trouble, God will live in them as strength.
37.40: Because of their faith in him, their daily portion will be a Father’s help and deliverance from evil. This is true for all who turn to hide themselves in him!

38.1: O Lord, don’t punish me angrily for what I’ve done. Don’t let my sin inflame your wrath against me.
38.2: For the arrows of your conviction have pierced me deeply. Your blows have struck my soul and crushed me.
38.3: Now my body is sick. My health is totally broken because of your anger, and it’s all due to my sins!
38.4: I’m overwhelmed, swamped, and submerged beneath the heavy burden of my guilt. It clings to me and won’t let me go.
38.5: My rotting wounds are a witness against me. They are severe and getting worse, reminding me of my failure and folly.
38.6: I am completely broken because of what I’ve done. Gloom is all around me. My sins have bent me over to the ground.
38.7: My inner being is shriveled up; my self-confidence crushed. Sick with fever, I’m left exhausted. Now I’m as cold as a corpse, and nothing is left inside me but great groaning filled with anguish.
38.8: I am exhausted and completely crushed. My groans come from an anguished heart.
38.9: Lord, you know all my desires and deepest longings. My tears are liquid words, and you can read them all.
38.10: My heart beats wildly, my strength is sapped, and the light of my eyes is going out. My friends stay far away from me, avoiding me like the plague. Even my family wants nothing to do with me.
38.11: My loved ones and friends stay away, fearing my disease. Even my own family stands at a distance.
38.12: Meanwhile my enemies are out to kill me, plotting my ruin, speaking of my doom as they spend every waking moment planning how to finish me off.
38.13: I’m like a deaf man who no longer hears. I can’t even speak up, and words fail me; I have no argument to counter their threats.
38.14: I choose to hear nothing, and I make no reply.
38.15: Lord, the only thing I can do is wait and put my hope in you. I wait for your help, my God.
38.16: So hear my cry and put an end to their strutting in pride, to those who gloat when I stumble in pain.
38.17: I’m slipping away and on the verge of a breakdown, with nothing but sorrow and sighing.
38.18: I confess all my sin to you; I can’t hold it in any longer. My agonizing thoughts punish me for my wrongdoing; I feel condemned as I consider all I’ve done.
38.19: My enemies are many. They hate me and persecute me, though I’ve done nothing against them to deserve it.
38.20: I show goodness to them and get paid evil in return. And they hate me even more when I stand for what is right.
38.21: So don’t forsake me now, Lord! Don’t leave me in this condition.
38.22: God, hurry to help me. Run to my rescue! For you’re my Savior and my only hope!

39.1: Here’s my life motto, the truth I live by: I will guard my ways for all my days. I will speak only what is right, guarding what I speak. Like a watchman guards against an attack of the enemy, I’ll guard and muzzle my mouth when the wicked are around me. I will remain silent and will not grumble or speak out of my disappointment. But the longer I’m silent, the more my pain grows worse!
39.2: But as I stood there in silence--not even speaking of good things--the turmoil within me grew to the bursting point.
39.3: My heart burned with a fire within me, and my thoughts eventually boiled over until they finally came rolling out of my mouth: “Lord, help me to know how fleeting my time on earth is. Help me to know how limited is my life and that I’m only here but for a moment more.
39.4: "LORD, remind me how brief my time on earth will be. Remind me that my days are numbered, and that my life is fleeing away.
39.5: What a brief time you’ve given me to live! Compared to you my lifetime is nothing at all! Nothing more than a puff of air—I’m gone so swiftly. So too are the grandest of men; they are nothing but a fleeting shadow!”
39.6: We live our lives like those living in shadows. All our activities and energies are spent for things that pass away. We gather, we hoard, we cling to our things, only to leave them all behind for who knows who.
39.7: And now, God, I’m left with one conclusion: my only hope is to hope in you alone!
39.8: Save me from being overpowered by my sin; don’t make me a disgrace before the degenerate.
39.9: Lord, I’m left speechless and I have no excuse, so I’ll not complain any longer. Now I know you’re the one who is behind it all.
39.10: But I can’t take it much longer. Spare me these blows from your discipline-rod. For if you are against me, I will waste away to nothing.
39.11: No one endures when you rebuke and discipline us for our sins. Like a cobweb is swept away with a wave of the hand, you sweep away all that we once called dear. How fleeting and frail our lives! We’re nothing more than a puff of air.
39.12: Lord, listen to all my tender cries. Read my every tear, like liquid words that plead for your help. I feel all alone at times, like a stranger to you, passing through this life just like all those before me.
39.13: Don’t let me die without restoring joy and gladness to my soul. May your frown over my failure become a smile over my success.

40.1: I waited and waited and waited some more, patiently, knowing God would come through for me. Then, at last, he bent down and listened to my cry.
40.2: He stooped down to lift me out of danger from the desolate pit I was in, out of the muddy mess I had fallen into. Now he’s lifted me up into a firm, secure place and steadied me while I walk along his ascending path.
40.3: A new song for a new day rises up in me every time I think about how he breaks through for me! Ecstatic praise pours out of my mouth until everyone hears how God has set me free. Many will see his miracles; they’ll stand in awe of God and fall in love with him!
40.4: Blessing after blessing comes to those who love and trust the Lord. They will not fall away, for they refuse to listen to the lies of the proud.
40.5: O Lord, our God, no one can compare with you. Such wonderful works and miracles are all found with you! And you think of us all the time with your countless expressions of love— far exceeding our expectations!
40.6: It’s not sacrifices that really move your heart. Burnt offerings, sin offerings—those aren’t what bring you joy. But when you open my ears and speak to me, I become your willing servant, your prisoner of love for life.
40.7: So I said, “Here I am! I’m coming to you as a sacrifice, for in the prophetic scrolls of your book you have written about me.
40.8: I delight to fulfill your will, my God, for your living words are written upon the pages of my heart.”
40.9: I tell everyone everywhere the truth of your righteousness. And you know I haven’t held back in telling the message to all.
40.10: I don’t keep it a secret or hide the truth. I preach of your faithfulness and kindness, proclaiming your extravagant love to the largest crowd I can find!
40.11: So Lord, don’t hold back your love or withhold your tender mercies from me. Keep me in your truth and let your compassion overflow to me no matter what I face.
40.12: Evil surrounds me; problems greater than I can solve come one after another. Without you, I know I can’t make it. My sins are so many! I’m so ashamed to lift my face to you. For my guilt grabs me and stings my soul until I am weakened and spent.
40.13: Please, Lord! Come quickly and rescue me! Take pleasure in showing me your favor and restore me.
40.14: Let all who seek my life be humiliated! Let them be confused and ashamed, God. Scatter those who wish me evil; they just want me dead.
40.15: Scoff at every scoffer and cause them all to be utter failures. Let them be ashamed and horrified by their complete defeat.
40.16: But let all who passionately seek you erupt with excitement and joy over what you’ve done! Let all your devoted lovers rejoice continually in the Savior, saying, “How great and glorious is our God!”
40.17: Lord, in my place of weakness and need, I ask again: Will you come and help me? I know I’m always in your thoughts. You are my true Savior and hero, so don’t delay to deliver me now, for you are my God.

41.1: God always blesses those who are kind to the poor and helpless. They’re the first ones God helps when they find themselves in any trouble.
41.2: The Lord will preserve and protect them. They’ll be honored and esteemed while their enemies are defeated.
41.3: When they are sick, lying upon their bed of suffering, God will restore them. He will raise them up again and restore them back to health.
41.4: So in my sickness I say to you, “Lord, be my kind healer. Heal my body and soul; heal me, God! For I have confessed my sins to you.”
41.5: But those who hate me wish the worst for me, saying, “When will he die and be forgotten?”
41.6: And when these “friends” come to visit me with their pious sympathy and their hollow words and with hypocrisy hidden in their hearts, I can see right through it all. For they come merely to gather gossip about me, using all they find to mock me with malicious hearts of slander.
41.7: They are wicked whisperers who imagine the worst for me, repeating their rumors, saying,
41.8: “He got what he deserved; it’s over for him! The spirit of infirmity is upon him, and he’ll never get over this illness.”
41.9: Even my ally, my friend, has turned against me. He was one I totally trusted with my life, sharing supper with him, and now he shows me nothing but betrayal and treachery. He has sold me as an enemy.
41.10: So Lord, please don’t desert me when I need you! Give me grace and get me back on my feet so I can triumph over them all.
41.11: Then I’ll know you’re pleased with me when you allow me to taste victory over all my foes.
41.12: Now stand up for me and don’t let me fall, for I’ve walked with integrity. Keep me before your face forever.
41.13: Everyone praise the Lord God of Israel, always and forever! For he is from eternity past and will remain for the eternity to come. That’s the way it will be forever. Faithful is our King! Amen!

42.1: I long to drink of you, O God, to drink deeply from the streams of pleasure flowing from your presence. My longings overwhelm me for more of you!
42.2: My soul thirsts, pants, and longs for the living God. I want to come and see the face of God.
42.3: Day and night my tears keep falling and my heart keeps crying for your help, while my enemies mock me over and over, saying, “Where is this God of yours? Why doesn’t he help you? ”
42.4: So I speak over my heartbroken soul, “Take courage. Remember when you used to be right out front leading the procession of praise when the great crowd of worshipers gathered to go into the presence of the Lord? You shouted with joy as the sound of passionate celebration filled the air and the joyous multitude of lovers honored the feast of the Lord!”
42.5: So then, my soul, why would you be depressed? Why would you sink into despair? Just keep hoping and waiting on God, your Savior. For no matter what, I will still sing with praise, for you are my saving grace!
42.6: Here I am depressed and downcast. Yet I will still remember you as I ponder the place where your glory streams down from the mighty mountaintops, lofty and majestic— the mountains of your awesome presence.
42.7: My deep need calls out to the deep kindness of your love. Your waterfall of weeping sent waves of sorrow over my soul, carrying me away, cascading over me like a thundering cataract.
42.8: All through the day Yahweh has commanded his endless love to pour over me. Through the night I sing his songs and my praises to the living God.
42.9: I will say to God, “You are my mountain of strength; how could you forget me? Why must I suffer this vile oppression of my enemies— these heartless tormentors who are out to kill me?”
42.10: Their wounding words pierce my heart over and over while they say, “Where is this God of yours?”
42.11: So I say to my soul, “Don’t be discouraged. Don’t be disturbed. For I know my God will break through for me.” Then I’ll have plenty of reasons to praise him all over again. Yes, he is my saving grace!

43.1: God, clear my name. Plead my case against the unjust charges of these ungodly workers of wickedness. Deliver me from these lying degenerates.
43.2: For you are where my strength comes from and my protector, so why would you leave me now? Must I be covered with gloom while the enemy comes after me, gloating with glee?
43.3: Pour into me the brightness of your daybreak! Pour into me your rays of revelation-truth! Let them comfort and gently lead me onto the shining path, showing the way into your burning presence, into your many sanctuaries of holiness.
43.4: Then I will come closer to your very altar until I come before you, the God of my ecstatic joy! I will praise you with the harp that plays in my heart to you, my God, my magnificent God!
43.5: Then I will say to my soul, “Don’t be discouraged; don’t be disturbed, for I fully expect my Savior-God to break through for me. Then I’ll have plenty of reasons to praise him all over again.” Yes, he is my saving grace!

44.1: God, we’ve heard about all the glorious miracles you’ve done for our ancestors in days gone by. They told us about the ancient times, how by your power you drove out the ungodly nations from this land, crushing all their strongholds and giving the land to us. Now the people of Israel cover the land from one end to the other, all because of your grace and power!
44.2: You drove out the pagan nations and gave all the land to our ancestors; you crushed their enemies, setting our ancestors free.
44.3: Our forefathers didn’t take the land by their own strength or their own skill or strategy. But it was through the shining forth of your radiant presence and the display of your mighty power. You loved to give them victory, for you took great delight in them.
44.4: You are my God, my King! It’s now time to decree majesties for Jacob!
44.5: Through your glorious name and your awesome power, we can push through to any victory and defeat every enemy.
44.6: For I will not trust in the weapons of the world; I know they will never save me.
44.7: Only you will be our Savior from all our enemies. All those who hate us you have brought to shame.
44.8: So now I constantly boast in you. I can never thank you enough!
44.9: But you have turned your back on us; you walked off and left us! You’ve rejected us, tossing us aside in humiliating shame. You don’t go before us anymore in our battles.
44.10: We retreat before our enemies in defeat, for you are no longer helping us. Those who hate us have invaded our land and plundered our people.
44.11: You have treated us like sheep in the slaughter pen, ready to be butchered. You’ve scattered us to the four winds.
44.12: You have sold us as slaves for nothing! You have counted us, your precious ones, as worthless.
44.13: You have caused our neighbors to despise and scorn us. All those around us mock and curse us.
44.14: You have made us the butt of their jokes. Disliked by all, we are the laughingstock of the people.
44.15: There’s no escape from this constant curse, this humiliation! We are despised, jeered, overwhelmed by shame, and overcome at every turn by our hateful and heartless enemies.
44.16: All we hear are the taunts of our mockers. All we see are our vengeful enemies.
44.17: Despite all of this, we have not forgotten you; we have not broken covenant with you.
44.18: We have not betrayed you; our hearts are still yours. Our steps have not strayed from your path.
44.19: Yet you have crushed us, leaving us in this wilderness place of misery and desperation. With nowhere else to turn, death’s dark door seems to be the only way out.
44.20: If we had forsaken your holy name, wouldn’t you know it? You’d be right in leaving us. If we had worshiped before other gods, no one would blame you for punishing us. God, you know our every heart-secret. You know we still want you!
44.21: God would surely have known it, for he knows the secrets of every heart.
44.22: Because of you we face death threats every day. Like martyrs we are dying daily. We are seen as lambs lined up to be slaughtered as sacrifices.
44.23: So wake up, Lord God! Why would you sleep when we’re in trouble? Are you forsaking us forever?
44.24: You can’t hide your face any longer from us! How could you forget our agonizing sorrow?
44.25: Now we lay facedown, sinking into the dust of death, the quicksand of the grave.
44.26: Arise, awake, and come to help us, O Lord. Let your unfailing love save us from this sorrow!

45.1: My heart is on fire, boiling over with passion. Bubbling up within me are these beautiful lyrics as a lovely poem to be sung for the King. Like a river bursting its banks, I’m overflowing with words, spilling out into this sacred story.
45.2: Beautiful! Beautiful! Beyond the sons of men! Elegant grace pours out through every word you speak. Truly God has anointed you, his favored one, for eternity!
45.3: Now strap your lightning-sword of judgment upon your side, O mighty warrior, so majestic! You are full of beauty and splendor as you go out to war!
45.4: In your glory and grandeur go forth in victory! Through your faithfulness and meekness the cause of truth and justice will stand. Awe-inspiring miracles are accomplished by your power, leaving everyone dazed and astonished!
45.5: Your wounding leaves men’s hearts defeated as they fall before you broken.
45.6: Your glory-kingdom, O God, endures forever, for you are enthroned to rule with a justice-scepter in your hand!
45.7: You are passionate for righteousness, and you hate lawlessness. This is why God, your God, crowns you with bliss above your fellow kings. He has anointed you, more than any other, with his oil of fervent joy, the very fragrance of heaven’s gladness.
45.8: Your royal robes release the scent of suffering love for your bride; the odor of aromatic incense is upon you. From the pure and shining place, lovely music that makes you glad is played for your pleasure.
45.9: The daughters of kings, women of honor, are maidens in your courts. And standing beside you, glistening in your pure and golden glory, is the beautiful bride-to-be!
45.10: Now listen, daughter, pay attention, and forget about your past. Put behind you every attachment to the familiar, even those who once were close to you!
45.11: For your royal Bridegroom is ravished by your beautiful brightness. Bow in reverence before him, for he is your Lord!
45.12: Wedding presents pour in from those of great wealth. The royal friends of the Bridegroom shower you with gifts.
45.13: As the princess-bride enters the palace, how glorious she appears within the holy chamber, robed with a wedding dress embroidered with pure gold!
45.14: Lovely and stunning, she leads the procession with all her bridesmaids as they come before you, her Bridegroom-King.
45.15: What a grand, majestic entrance! A joyful, glad procession as they enter the palace gates!
45.16: Your many sons will one day be kings, just like their Father. They will sit on royal thrones all around the world.
45.17: I will make sure the fame of your name is honored in every generation, as all the people praise you, giving you thanks forever and ever!

46.1: God, you’re such a safe and powerful place to find refuge! You’re a proven help in time of trouble— more than enough and always available whenever I need you.
46.2: So we will never fear even if every structure of support were to crumble away. We will not fear even when the earth quakes and shakes, moving mountains and casting them into the sea.
46.3: For the raging roar of stormy winds and crashing waves cannot erode our faith in you.
46.4: God has a constantly flowing river whose sparkling streams bring joy and delight to his people. His river flows right through the city of God Most High, into his holy dwelling places.
46.5: God is in the midst of his city, secure and never shaken. At daybreak his help will be seen with the appearing of the dawn.
46.6: When the nations are in uproar with their tottering kingdoms, God simply raises his voice, and the earth begins to disintegrate before him.
46.7: Here he comes! The Commander! The mighty Lord of Angel Armies is on our side! The God of Jacob fights for us!
46.8: Everyone look! Come and see the breathtaking wonders of our God. For he brings both ruin and revival. He’s the one who makes conflicts end throughout the earth, breaking and burning every weapon of war.
46.9: and causes wars to end throughout the earth. He breaks the bow and snaps the spear in two; he burns the shields with fire.
46.10: Surrender your anxiety. Be still and realize that I am God. I am God above all the nations, and I am exalted throughout the whole earth.
46.11: Here he stands! The Commander! The mighty Lord of Angel Armies is on our side! The God of Jacob fights for us!

47.1: Go ahead and celebrate! Come on and clap your hands, everyone! Shout to God with the raucous sounds of joy!
47.2: The Lord God Most High is astonishing, awesome beyond words! He’s the formidable and powerful King over all the earth.
47.3: He’s the one who conquered the nations before us and placed them all under our feet.
47.4: He’s marked out our inheritance ahead of time, putting us in the front of the line, honoring Jacob, the one he loves.
47.5: God arises with the earsplitting shout of his people! God goes up with a trumpet blast!
47.6: Sing and celebrate! Sing some more, celebrate some more! Sing your highest song of praise to our King!
47.7: For God is the triumphant King; all the powers of the earth are his. So sing your celebration songs of highest praise to the glorious Enlightened One!
47.8: Our God reigns over every nation. He reigns on his holy throne over all.
47.9: All the nobles and princes, the loving servants of the God of Abraham, they all gather to worship. Every warrior’s shield is now lowered as surrendered trophies before this King. He has taken his throne, high and lofty, exalted over all!

48.1: There are so many reasons to describe God as wonderful! So many reasons to praise him with unlimited praise!
48.2: Zion-City is his home; he lives on his holy mountain— high and glorious, joy-filled and favored. Zion-Mountain looms in the farthest reaches of the north, the city of our incomparable King!
48.3: This is his divine abode, an impenetrable citadel, for he is known to dwell in the highest place.
48.4: See how the mighty kings united to come against Zion, yet when they saw God manifest in front of their eyes, they were stunned. Trembling, they all fled away, gripped with fear. Seized with panic, they doubled up in frightful anguish, like a woman in the labor pains of childbirth.
48.5: But when they saw it, they were stunned; they were terrified and ran away.
48.6: They were gripped with terror, like a woman writhing in the pain of childbirth
48.7: Like a hurricane blowing and breaking the invading ships, God blows upon them and breaks them to pieces.
48.8: We have heard about these wonders, and then we saw them with our own eyes. For this is the city of the Commander of Angel Armies, the city of our God, safe and secure forever!
48.9: Lord, as we worship you in your temple, we recall over and over your kindness to us and your unending love.
48.10: The fame of your name echoes throughout the entire world, accompanied with praises. Your right hand is full of victory.
48.11: So let the people of Zion rejoice with gladness; let the daughters of praise leap for joy! For God will see to it that you are judged fairly.
48.12: Circle Zion; count her towers. Consider her walls, climb her palaces, and then go and tell the coming generation of the care and compassion of our God.
48.13: Take note of the fortified walls, and tour all the citadels, that you may describe them to future generations.
48.14: Yes, this is our God, our great God forever. He will lead us onward until the end, through all time, beyond death, and into eternity!

49.1: Listen, one and all! Both rich and poor together, all over the world— everyone listen to what I have to say!
49.2: High and low, rich and poor--listen!
49.3: For wisdom will come from my mouth; words of insight and understanding will be heard from the musings of my heart.
49.4: I will break open mysteries with my music, and my song will release riddles solved.
49.5: There’s no reason to fear when troubling times come, even when you’re surrounded with problems and persecutors who chase at your heels.
49.6: They trust in their treasures and boast in their riches, yet not one of them, though rich as a king, could rescue his own brother from the guilt of his sins. No one could give God the ransom price for the soul of another, let alone for himself.
49.7: Yet they cannot redeem themselves from death by paying a ransom to God.
49.8: A soul’s redemption is too costly and precious for anyone to pay with earthly wealth. The price to pay is never enough to purchase eternal life for even one, to keep them out of hell.
49.9: to live forever and never see the grave.
49.10: The brightest and best, along with the foolish and senseless, God sees that they all will die one day, leaving their houses and wealth to others. Even though they name streets and lands after themselves, hoping to have their memory endure beyond the grave, becoming legends in their own minds, their home address is now the cemetery!
49.11: The grave is their eternal home, where they will stay forever. They may name their estates after themselves, but they leave their wealth to others.
49.12: The honor of man is short-lived and fleeting. There’s little difference between man and beast, for both will one day perish.
49.13: Such is the path of foolish men and those who quote everything they say, for they are here today and gone tomorrow!
49.14: A shepherd called “Death” herds them, leading them straight to hell like mindless sheep. Yet at daybreak you will find the righteous ruling in their place. Every trace of them will be gone forever, with all their “glory” lost in the darkness of their doom.
49.15: But I know the loving God will redeem my soul, raising me up from the dark power of death, taking me as his bridal partner.
49.16: So don’t be disturbed when you see the rich surround you with the “glory” of their wealth on full display.
49.17: For when they die, they will carry nothing with them, and their riches will not follow them beyond the grave.
49.18: Though they have the greatest rewards of this world and all applaud them for their accomplishments, they will follow those who have gone before them and go straight into the realm of darkness, where they will never ever see the light again.
49.19: But they will die like all others before them and never again see the light of day.
49.20: So this is the way of mortal man— honored for a moment, yet without eternal insight, like a beast that will one day perish.

50.1: The God of gods, the mighty Lord himself, has spoken! He shouts out over all the people of the earth in every brilliant sunrise and every beautiful sunset, saying, “Listen to me!”
50.2: God’s glory-light shines out of the Zion-realm with the radiance of perfect beauty.
50.3: With the rumble of thunder he approaches; he will not be silent, for he comes with an earsplitting sound! All around him are furious flames of fire, and preceding him is the dazzling blaze of his glory.
50.4: Here he comes to judge his people! He summons his court with heaven and earth as his jury, saying,
50.5: “Gather all my devoted lovers, my godly ones whose hearts are one with me— those who have entered into my holy covenant by sacrifices upon the altar.”
50.6: And the heavens declare his justice: “God himself will be their judge, and he will judge them with righteousness!”
50.7: “Listen to me, O my people! Listen well, for I am your God! I am bringing you to trial, and here are my charges.
50.8: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, which you continually bring to my altar.
50.9: Do I need your young bulls or goats from your fields as if I were hungry?
50.10: Every animal of field and forest belongs to me, the Creator. I know every movement of the birds in the sky, and every animal of the field is in my thoughts. The entire world and everything it contains is mine.
50.11: Every bird of the mountains and all the animals of the field belong to me.
50.12: If I were hungry, do you think I would tell you? For all that I have created, the fullness of the earth, is mine. Am I fed by your sacrifices? Of course not!
50.13: I don't need the bulls you sacrifice; I don't need the blood of goats.
50.14: Why don’t you bring me the sacrifices I desire? Bring me your true and sincere thanks, and show your gratitude by keeping your promises to me, the Most High.
50.15: Honor me by trusting in me in your day of trouble. Cry aloud to me, and I will be there to rescue you.
50.16: And now I speak to the wicked. Listen to what I have to say to you! What right do you have to presume to speak for me and claim my covenant promises as yours?
50.17: For you have hated my instruction and disregarded my words, throwing them away as worthless!
50.18: You forget to condemn the thief or adulterer. You are their friend, running alongside them into darkness.
50.19: The sins of your mouth multiply evil. You have a lifestyle of lies; you are devoted to deceit as you speak against others, even slandering those of your own household!
50.20: You sit around and slander a brother--your own mother's son.
50.21: All this you have done and I kept silent, so you thought that I was just like you, sanctioning evil. But now I will bring you to my courtroom and spell out clearly my charges before you.
50.22: This is your last chance, my final warning. Your time is up! Turn away from all this evil, or the next time you hear from me will be when I am coming to pass judgment upon you. I will snatch you away, and no one will be there to help you escape my judgment.
50.23: The life that pleases me is a life lived in the gratitude of grace, always choosing to walk with me in what is right. This is the sacrifice I desire from you. If you do this, more of my salvation will unfold for you.”

51.1: God, give me mercy from your fountain of forgiveness! I know your abundant love is enough to wash away my guilt. Because your compassion is so great, take away this shameful guilt of sin. Forgive the full extent of my rebellious ways, and erase this deep stain on my conscience.
51.2: Wash me clean from my guilt. Purify me from my sin.
51.3: For I’m so ashamed. I feel such pain and anguish within me. I can’t get away from the sting of my sin against you, Lord! Everything I did, I did right in front of you, for you saw it all. Against you, and you above all, have I sinned. Everything you say to me is infallibly true and your judgment conquers me.
51.4: Against you, and you alone, have I sinned; I have done what is evil in your sight. You will be proved right in what you say, and your judgment against me is just.
51.5: Lord, I have been a sinner from birth, from the moment my mother conceived me.
51.6: I know that you delight to set your truth deep in my spirit. So come into the hidden places of my heart and teach me wisdom.
51.7: Purify my conscience! Make this leper clean again! Wash me in your love until I am pure in heart.
51.8: Satisfy me in your sweetness, and my song of joy will return. The places you have crushed within me will rejoice in your healing touch.
51.9: Hide my sins from your face; erase all my guilt by your saving grace.
51.10: Keep creating in me a clean heart. Fill me with pure thoughts and holy desires, ready to please you.
51.11: May you never reject me! May you never take from me your sacred Spirit!
51.12: Let my passion for life be restored, tasting joy in every breakthrough you bring to me. Hold me close to you with a willing spirit that obeys whatever you say.
51.13: Then I can show other guilty ones how loving and merciful you are. They will find their way back home to you, knowing that you will forgive them.
51.14: O God, my saving God, deliver me fully from every sin, even the sin that brought bloodguilt. Then my heart will once again be thrilled to sing the passionate songs of joy and deliverance!
51.15: Lord God, unlock my heart, unlock my lips, and I will overcome with my joyous praise!
51.16: For the source of your pleasure is not in my performance or the sacrifices I might offer to you.
51.17: The fountain of your pleasure is found in the sacrifice of my shattered heart before you. You will not despise my tenderness as I bow down humbly at your feet.
51.18: Because you favor Zion, do what is good for her. Be the protecting wall around Jerusalem.
51.19: And when we are fully restored, you will rejoice and take delight in every offering of our lives as we bring our sacrifices of righteousness before you in love!

52.1: You call yourself a mighty man, a big shot? Why do you boast in the evil you have done? Yet God’s loyal love will protect me and carry the day!
52.2: Listen, O deceiver, trickster of others: Your words are wicked, harming and hurting all who hear them.
52.3: You love evil and hate what is good and right. You would rather lie than tell the truth.
52.4: You love to distort, devour, and deceive, using your sly tongue to spin the truth.
52.5: But the Almighty will strike you down forever! He will pull you up by your roots and drag you away to the darkness of death.
52.6: The godly will see all this and will be awestruck. Then they will laugh at the wicked, saying,
52.7: “See what happens to those great in their own eyes who don’t trust in the Most High to save them! Look how they trusted only in their wealth and made their living from wickedness.”
52.8: But I am like a flourishing olive tree, anointed in the house of God. I trust in the unending love of God; his passion toward me is forever and ever.
52.9: Because it is finished, I will praise you forever and give you thanks. Before all your godly lovers I will proclaim your beautiful name!

53.1: Only the withering soul would say to himself, “There’s no God for me!” Anyone who thinks like that is corrupt and callous; depraved and detestable, they are devoid of what is good.
53.2: The Lord looks down in love, bending over heaven’s balcony. God looks over all of Adam’s sons and daughters, looking to see if there are any who are wise with insight— any who search for him, wanting to please him.
53.3: But no, all have wandered astray, walking stubbornly toward evil. Not one is good; he can’t even find one!
53.4: Look how they live in luxury while exploiting my people. Won’t these workers of wickedness ever learn! They never even think of praying to God.
53.5: Soon, unheard-of terror will seize them while in their sins. God himself will one day scatter the bones of those who rose up against you. Doomed and rejected, they will be put to shame, for God has despised them.
53.6: Oh, I wish our time of rescue were already here. Oh, that God would come forth now — arising from the midst of his Zion-people to save and restore his very own. When God fully restores his people, Jacob will rejoice, and Israel will be filled with gladness!

54.1: God, deliver me by your mighty name! Come with your glorious power and save me!
54.2: Listen to my prayer; turn your ears to my cry!
54.3: These violent men have risen up against me; heartless, ruthless men who care nothing about God seek to take my life.
54.4: But the Lord God has become my divine helper. He leans into my heart and lays his hands upon me!
54.5: God will see to it that those who sow evil will reap evil. So Lord, in your great faithfulness, destroy them once and for all!
54.6: Lord, I will offer myself freely, and everything I am I give to you. I will worship and praise your name, O Lord, for it is precious to me.
54.7: Through you I’m saved—rescued from every trouble. I’ve seen with my eyes the defeat of my enemies. I’ve triumphed over them all!

55.1: God, listen to my prayer! Don’t hide your heart from me when I cry out to you!
55.2: Come close to me and give me your answer. Here I am, moaning and restless. I’m preoccupied with the threats of my enemies and crushed by the pressure of their opposition. They surround me with trouble and terror. In their fury they rise up against me in an angry uproar.
55.3: My enemies shout at me, making loud and wicked threats. They bring trouble on me, hunting me down in their anger.
55.4: My heart is trembling inside my chest as the terror of death seizes me.
55.5: Fear and dread overwhelm me. I shudder before the horror I face.
55.6: I say to myself, “If only I could fly away from all of this! If only I could run away to the place of rest and peace.
55.7: I would run far away where no one could find me, escaping to a wilderness retreat.”
55.8: I will hurry off to hide in the higher place, into my shelter, safe from this raging storm and tempest.
55.9: God, confuse them until they quarrel with themselves. Destroy them with their own violent strife and slander. They have divided the city with their discord.
55.10: Though they patrol the walls night and day against invaders, the real danger is within the city— the misery and strife in the hearts of its people.
55.11: Murder is in their midst. Wherever you turn, you find trouble and ruin.
55.12: It wasn’t an enemy who taunted me. If it was my enemy, filled with pride and hatred, then I could have endured it. I would have just run away.
55.13: But it was you, my intimate friend—one like a brother to me. It was you, my adviser, the companion I walked with and worked with!
55.14: We once had sweet fellowship with each other. We worshiped in unity as one, celebrating together with God’s people.
55.15: Now desolation and darkness has come upon you. May you and all those like you descend into the pit of destruction! Since evil has been your home, may evil now bury you alive!
55.16: But as for me, I will call upon the Lord to save me, and I know he will!
55.17: Every evening I will explain my need to him. Every morning I will move my soul toward him. Every waking hour I will worship only him, and he will hear and respond to my cry.
55.18: Though many wish to fight and the tide of battle turns against me, by your power I will be safe and secure; peace will be my portion.
55.19: God himself will hear me! God-Enthroned through everlasting ages, the God of unchanging faithfulness— he will put them in their place, all those who refuse to love and revere him!
55.20: I was betrayed by my friend, though I lived in peace with him. While he was stretching out his hand of friendship, he was secretly breaking every promise he had ever made to me!
55.21: His words were smooth and charming. Yet his heart was disloyal and full of hatred— his words soft as silk while all the time scheming my demise.
55.22: So here’s what I’ve learned through it all: Leave all your cares and anxieties at the feet of the Lord, and measureless grace will strengthen you.
55.23: He will watch over his devoted lovers, never letting them slip or be overthrown. He will send all my enemies to the pit of destruction. Murderers, liars, and betrayers will face an untimely death. My life’s hope and trust is in you, and you’ll never fail to rescue me!

56.1: Lord, show me your kindness and mercy, for these men oppose and oppress me all day long.
56.2: Not a day goes by without somebody harassing me. So many in their pride trample me under their feet.
56.3: But in the day that I’m afraid, I lay all my fears before you and trust in you with all my heart.
56.4: What harm could a man bring to me? With God on my side, I will not be afraid of what comes. The roaring praises of God fill my heart as I trust his promises.
56.5: Day after day cruel critics distort my words; constantly they plot my collapse.
56.6: They lurk in the dark, waiting, spying on my movements in secret to take me by surprise, ready to take my life.
56.7: They don’t deserve to get away with this! Look at their wickedness, their injustice, Lord. In your fierce anger cast them down to defeat.
56.8: You’ve kept track of all my wandering and my weeping. You’ve stored my many tears in your bottle—not one will be lost. For they are all recorded in your book of remembrance.
56.9: The very moment I call to you for a father’s help the tide of battle turns and my enemies flee. This one thing I know: God is on my side!
56.10: I trust in the Lord. And I praise him! I trust in the Word of God. And I praise him!
56.11: What harm could man do to me? With God on my side, I will not be afraid of what comes. My heart overflows with praise to God and for his promises. I will always trust in him.
56.12: So I’m thanking you with all my heart, with gratitude for all you’ve done. I will do everything I’ve promised you, Lord.
56.13: For you have saved my soul from death and my feet from stumbling so that I can walk before the Lord bathed in his life-giving light.

57.1: Please, God, show me mercy! Open your grace-fountain for me, for you are my soul’s true shelter. I will hide beneath the shadow of your embrace, under the wings of your cherubim, until this terrible trouble is past.
57.2: I will cry out to you, the God of the highest heaven, the mighty God, who performs all these wonders for me.
57.3: From heaven he will send a father’s help to save me. He will trample down those who trample me. He will always show me love by his gracious and constant care.
57.4: I am surrounded by these fierce and brutal men. They are like lions just wanting to tear me to shreds. Why must I continue to live among these seething terrorists, breathing out their angry threats and insults against me?
57.5: Lord God, be exalted as you soar throughout the heavens. May your shining glory be seen in the skies! Let it be seen high above over all the earth!
57.6: For they have set a trap for me. Frantic fear has me overwhelmed. But look! The very trap they set for me has sprung shut upon themselves instead of me!
57.7: My heart, O God, is quiet and confident. Now I can sing with passion your wonderful praises!
57.8: Awake, O my soul, with the music of his splendor-song! Arise, my soul, and sing his praises! My worship will awaken the dawn, greeting the daybreak with my songs of praise!
57.9: Wherever I go, I will thank you, my God. Among all the nations they will hear my praise songs to you.
57.10: Your love is so extravagant it reaches to the heavens; your faithfulness so astonishing it stretches to the sky!
57.11: Lord God, be exalted as you soar throughout the heavens. May your shining glory be shown in the skies! Let it be seen high above all the earth!

58.1: God’s justice? You high and mighty politicians know nothing about it! Which one of you has walked in justice toward others? Which one of you has treated everyone right and fair? Not one! You only give “justice” in exchange for a bribe. For the right price you let others get away with murder.
58.2: No, all your dealings are crooked; you hand out violence instead of justice.
58.3: Wicked wanderers even from the womb—that’s who you are! You lie with your words, and your teaching is poison.
58.4: They spit poison like deadly snakes; they are like cobras that refuse to listen,
58.5: Like cobras closing their ears to the most expert of the charmers, you strike out against all who are near.
58.6: O God, break their fangs; shatter the teeth of these ravenous lions!
58.7: Let them disappear like water falling on thirsty ground. Let all their weapons be useless.
58.8: Let them be like snails dissolving into the slime. Let them be cut off, never seeing the light of day!
58.9: God will sweep them away so fast that they’ll never know what hit them.
58.10: The godly will celebrate in the triumph of good over evil, and the lovers of God will trample the wickedness of the wicked under their feet!
58.11: Then everyone will say, “There is a God who judges the judges” and “There is a great reward in loving God!”

59.1: My God, protect me! Keep me safe from all my enemies, for they’re coming to kill me. Put me in a high place out of their reach— a place so high that these assassins will never find me.
59.2: Save me from these murdering men, these bloodthirsty killers.
59.3: See how they set an ambush for my life. They’re fierce men ready to launch their attack against me. O Lord, I’m innocent; protect me!
59.4: I’ve done nothing to deserve this, yet they are already plotting together to kill me. Arise, Lord, see what they’re scheming, and come and meet with me.
59.5: Awaken, O God of Israel! Commander of Angel Armies, arise to punish these treacherous people who oppose you! Don’t go soft on these hard-core killers!
59.6: After dark they came to spy, sneaking around the city, snarling, prowling like a pack of stray dogs in the night—
59.7: boiling over with rage, shouting out their curses, convinced that they’ll never get caught.
59.8: But you, Lord, break out laughing at their plans, amused by their arrogance, scoffing at their sinful ways.
59.9: My strength is found when I wait upon you. Watch over me, God, for you are my mountain fortress; you set me on high!
59.10: The God of passionate love will meet with me. My God will empower me to rise in triumph over my foes.
59.11: Don’t kill them; stagger them all with a vivid display of power and scatter them with your armies of angels, O mighty God, our protector! Use your awesome power to make them wanderers and vagabonds and then bring them down.
59.12: They are nothing but proud, cursing liars. They sin in every word they speak, boasting in their blasphemies!
59.13: May your wrath be kindled to destroy them; finish them off! Make an end of them and their deeds until they are no more! Let them all know and learn that God is the ruler over Jacob, the God-King over all the earth!
59.14: Here they come again— prowling, growling like a pack of stray dogs in the city.
59.15: Drifting, devouring, and coming in for the kill, they refuse to sleep until they’ve eaten their fill.
59.16: But as for me, your strength shall be my song of joy. At each and every sunrise, my lyrics of your love will fill the air! For you have been my glory-fortress, a stronghold in my day of distress.
59.17: O my strength, I sing with joy your praises. O my stronghold, I sing with joy your song! O my Savior, I sing with joy the lyrics of your faithful love for me!

60.1: God, it seems like you walked off and left us! Why have you turned against us? You have been angry with us. O Lord, we plead, come back and help us as a father.
60.2: The earth quivers and quakes before you, splitting open and breaking apart. Now come and heal it, for it is shaken to its depths.
60.3: You have taught us hard lessons and made us drink the wine of bewilderment.
60.4: You have given miraculous signs to those who love you. As we follow you, we fly the flag of truth, and all who love the truth will rally to it.
60.5: Come to your beloved ones and gently draw us out. For Lord, you save those whom you love. Come with your might and strength!
60.6: Then I heard the Lord speak in his holy splendor. From his sanctuary I heard the Lord promise: “In my triumph I will be the one to measure out the portion of my inheritance to my people, and I will secure the land as I promised you. Shechem, Succoth, Gilead, Manasseh, they are all still mine!” he says. “Judah will continue to produce kings and lawgivers, and Ephraim will produce great warriors.
60.7: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim will produce my warriors, and Judah will produce my kings.
60.8: Moab will become my lowly servant. Edom will likewise serve my purposes. I will lift up a shout of victory over the land of Philistia!
60.9: But who will bring my triumph into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom’s fortresses?”
60.10: Have you really rejected us, refusing to fight our battles?
60.11: Give us a father’s help when we face our enemies. For to trust in any man is an empty hope.
60.12: With God’s help we will fight like heroes, and he will trample down our every foe!

61.1: O God, hear my prayer. Listen to my heart’s cry.
61.2: For no matter where I am, even when I’m far from home, I will cry out to you for a father’s help. When I’m feeble and overwhelmed by life, guide me into your glory, where I am safe and sheltered.
61.3: Lord, you are a paradise of protection to me. You lift me high above the fray. None of my foes can touch me when I’m held firmly in your wraparound presence!
61.4: Keep me in this glory. Let me live continually under your splendor-shadow, hiding my life in you forever.
61.5: You have heard my sweet resolutions to love and serve you, for I am your beloved. And you have given me an inheritance of rich treasures, which you give to all your devoted lovers.
61.6: You treat me like a king, giving me a full and abundant life, years and years of reigning, like many generations rolled into one.
61.7: I will live enthroned with you forever! Guard me, God, with your unending, unfailing love. Let me live my days walking in grace and truth before you.
61.8: And my praises will fill the heavens forever, fulfilling my vow to make every day a love-gift to you!

62.1: I stand silently to listen for the one I love, waiting as long as it takes for the Lord to rescue me. For God alone has become my Savior.
62.2: He alone is my safe place; his wraparound presence always protects me. For he is my champion defender; there’s no risk of failure with God. So why would I let worry paralyze me, even when troubles multiply around me?
62.3: But look at these who want me dead, shouting their vicious threats at me! The moment they discover my weakness, they all begin plotting to take me down.
62.4: Liars, hypocrites, with nothing good to say— all their energies are spent on moving me from this exalted place.
62.5: I am standing in absolute stillness, silent before the one I love, waiting as long as it takes for him to rescue me. Only God is my Savior, and he will not fail me.
62.6: For he alone is my safe place. His wraparound presence always protects me as my champion defender. There’s no risk of failure with God! So why would I let worry paralyze me, even when troubles multiply around me?
62.7: God’s glory is all around me! His wraparound presence is all I need, for the Lord is my Savior, my hero, and my life-giving strength.
62.8: Trust only in God every moment! Tell him all your troubles and pour out your heart-longings to him. Believe me when I tell you—he will help you!
62.9: Before God all the people of the earth, high or low, are like smoke that disappears, like a vapor that quickly vanishes away. Compared to God they’re nothing but vanity, nothing at all!
62.10: The wealth of the world is nothing to God. So if your wealth increases, don’t be boastful or put your trust in your money. And don’t you think for a moment that you can get away with stealing by overcharging others just to get more for yourself!
62.11: God said to me once and for all, “All the strength and power you need flows from me!” And again I heard it clearly said,
62.12: “All the love you need is found in me!” And it’s true that you repay people for what they do.

63.1: O God of my life, I’m lovesick for you in this weary wilderness. I thirst with the deepest longings to love you more, with cravings in my heart that can’t be described. Such yearning grips my soul for you, my God!
63.2: I’m energized every time I enter your heavenly sanctuary to seek more of your power and drink in more of your glory.
63.3: For your tender mercies mean more to me than life itself. How I love and praise you, God!
63.4: Daily I will worship you passionately and with all my heart. My arms will wave to you like banners of praise.
63.5: I overflow with praise when I come before you, for the anointing of your presence satisfies me like nothing else. You are such a rich banquet of pleasure to my soul.
63.6: I lie awake each night thinking of you and reflecting on how you help me like a father. I sing through the night under your splendor-shadow, offering up to you my songs of delight and joy!
63.7: I think how much you have helped me; I sing for joy in the shadow of your protecting wings.
63.8: With passion I pursue and cling to you. Because I feel your grip on my life, I keep my soul close to your heart.
63.9: Those who plot to destroy me shall descend into the darkness of hell.
63.10: They will be consumed by their own evil and become nothing more than dust under our feet.
63.11: These liars will be silenced forever! But with the anointing of a king I will dance and rejoice along with all his devoted lovers who trust in him.

64.1: Lord, can’t you hear my cry, my bitter complaint? Keep me safe from this band of criminals and from the conspiracy of these wicked men. They gather in their secret counsel to destroy me.
64.2: Protect me from the plots of the wicked, from the scheming of those who do evil.
64.3: Can’t you hear their slander, their lies? Their words are like poison-tipped arrows shot from the shadows. They are unafraid and have no fear of consequences.
64.4: They shoot from ambush at the innocent, attacking suddenly and fearlessly.
64.5: They persist with their evil plans and plot together to hide their traps. They boast, “No one can see us or stop us!”
64.6: They search out opportunities to pervert justice as they plan the “perfect crime.” How unsearchable is their endless evil! They try desperately to hide the deep darkness of their hearts.
64.7: But all the while God has his own fire-tipped arrows! Suddenly, without warning, they will be pierced and struck down.
64.8: Staggering backward, they will be destroyed by the very ones they spoke against. All who see this will view them with scorn.
64.9: Then all will stand awestruck over what God has done, seeing how he vindicated the victims of these crimes.
64.10: The lovers of God will be glad, rejoicing in the Lord. They will be found in his glorious wraparound presence, singing songs of praise to God!

65.1: O God in Zion, to you even silence is praise! You who answers prayer, all of humanity comes before you with their requests.
65.2: for you answer our prayers, and to you all people will come.
65.3: Though we are overcome by our many sins, your sacrifice covers over them all.
65.4: How blessed is the one you choose to live near you in your courts. The beauty of your house, your holy temple, satisfies us.
65.5: You answer our prayers with amazing wonders and with awe-inspiring displays of power. You are the righteous God who helps us like a father. Everyone everywhere looks to you, for you are the confidence of all the earth, even to the farthest islands of the sea.
65.6: What jaw-dropping, astounding power is yours! You are the mountain maker who sets them all in place.
65.7: You muzzle the roar of the mighty seas and the rage of mobs with their noisy riots.
65.8: O God, to the farthest corners of the planet people will stand in awe, startled and stunned by your signs and wonders. Sunrise brilliance and sunset beauty both take turns singing their songs of joy to you.
65.9: Your visitations of glory bless the earth; the rivers of God overflow and enrich it. You paint the wheat fields golden as you provide rich harvests.
65.10: Every field is watered with the abundance of rain— showers soaking the earth and softening its clods, causing seeds to sprout throughout the land.
65.11: You crown the earth with the fruits of your goodness. Wherever you go, the tracks of your chariot wheels drip with oil.
65.12: Luxuriant green pastures boast of your bounty as you make every hillside blossom with joy.
65.13: The grazing meadows are covered with flocks, and the fertile valleys are clothed with grain, each one dancing and shouting for joy, creation’s celebration! They’re all singing their songs of praise to you!

66.1: Everyone everywhere, lift up your joyful shout to God!
66.2: Sing your songs tuned to his glory! Tell the world how wonderful he is.
66.3: For he’s the awe-inspiring God, great and glorious in power! We’ve never seen anything like him! Mighty in miracles, you cause your enemies to tremble. No wonder they all surrender and bow before you!
66.4: All the earth will bow down to worship; all the earth will sing your glories forever!
66.5: Everyone will say, “Come and see the incredible things God has done; it will take your breath away! He multiplies miracles for his people!”
66.6: He made a highway going right through the Red Sea as the Hebrews passed through on dry ground, exploding with joyous excitement over the miracles of God.
66.7: In his great and mighty power he rules forever, watching over every movement of every nation. So beware, rebel lands; he knows how to humble you!
66.8: Praise God, all you peoples. Praise him everywhere and let everyone know you love him!
66.9: There’s no doubt about it: God holds our lives safely in his hands. He’s the one who keeps us faithfully following him.
66.10: O Lord, we have passed through your fire; like precious metal made pure, you’ve proved us, perfected us, and made us holy.
66.11: You’ve captured us, ensnared us in your net. Then, like prisoners, you placed chains around our necks.
66.12: You’ve allowed our enemies to prevail against us. We’ve passed through fire and flood, yet in the end you always bring us out better than we were before, saturated with your goodness.
66.13: I come before your presence with my sacrifice. I’ll give you all that I’ve promised, everything I have.
66.14: When I was overcome in my anguish, I promised to give you my sacrifice. Here it is! All that I said I would offer you is yours.
66.15: I’ll throw it all—the best I have to bring—into the fire as the fragrance of my sacrifice ascends unto you.
66.16: All you lovers of God who want to please him, come and listen, and I’ll tell you what he did for me.
66.17: I cried aloud to him with all my heart, and he answered me! Now my mouth overflows with the highest praise.
66.18: Yet if I had closed my eyes to my sin, the Lord God would have closed his ears to my prayer.
66.19: But praises rise to God, for he paid attention to my prayer and answered my cry to him!
66.20: I will forever praise this God who didn’t close his heart when I prayed and never said no when I asked him for help. He never once refused to show me his tender love.

67.1: God, keep us near your mercy-fountain and bless us! And when you look down on us, may your face beam with joy!
67.2: Send us out all over the world so that everyone everywhere will discover your ways and know who you are and see your power to save.
67.3: Let all the nations burst forth with praise; let everyone everywhere love and enjoy you!
67.4: Then how glad the nations will be when you are their King. They will sing, they will shout, for you give true justice to the people. Yes! You, Lord, are the shepherd of the nations!
67.5: No wonder the peoples praise you! Let all the people praise you more!
67.6: The harvest of the earth is here! God, the very God we worship, keeps us satisfied at his banquet of blessings.
67.7: And the blessings keep coming! All the ends of the earth will give him the honor he deserves and be in awe of him!

68.1: God! Arise with awesome power, and every one of your enemies will scatter in fear!
68.2: Chase them away—all these God-haters. Blow them away as a puff of smoke. Melt them away like wax in the fire. One good look at you and the wicked vanish.
68.3: But let all the righteous be glad! Yes, let them all rejoice in your presence and be carried away with gladness. Let them laugh and be radiant with joy!
68.4: Let them sing their celebration-songs for the coming of the cloud rider whose name is Yah!
68.5: To the fatherless he is a father. To the widow he is a champion friend. The lonely he makes part of a family. The prisoners he leads into prosperity until they sing for joy. This is our Holy God in his Holy Place! But for the rebels there is heartache and despair.
68.6: God places the lonely in families; he sets the prisoners free and gives them joy. But for rebels, there is only famine and distress.
68.7: O Lord, it was you who marched in front of your people, leading them through the wasteland.
68.8: The earth shook beneath your feet; the heavens filled with clouds before the presence of the God of Sinai. The sacred mountain shook at the sight of the face of Israel’s God.
68.9: You, O God, sent the reviving rain upon your weary inheritance, showers of blessing to refresh it.
68.10: So there your people settled. And in your kindness you provided the poor with abundance.
68.11: God Almighty declares the word of the gospel with power, and the warring women of Zion deliver its message:
68.12: “The conquering legions have themselves been conquered. Look at them flee!” Now Zion’s women are left to gather the spoils.
68.13: When you sleep between sharpened stakes, I see you sparkling like silver and glistening like gold, covered by the beautiful wings of a dove!
68.14: When the Almighty found a king for himself, it became white as snow in his shade.
68.15: O huge, magnificent mountain, you are the mighty kingdom of God! All the other peaks, though impressive and imposing, look with envy on you, Mount Zion! For Zion is the mountain where God has chosen to live forever.
68.16: Why do you look with envy, O rugged mountains, at Mount Zion, where God has chosen to live, where the LORD himself will live forever?
68.17: Look! The mighty chariots of God! Ten thousands upon ten thousands, more than anyone could ever number. God is at the front, leading them all from Mount Sinai into his sanctuary with the radiance of holiness upon him.
68.18: He ascends into the heavenly heights, taking his many captured ones with him, leading them in triumphal procession. And gifts were given to men, even the once rebellious, so that they may dwell with Yah.
68.19: What a glorious God! He gives us salvation over and over, then daily he carries our burdens!
68.20: Our God is a mighty God who saves us over and over! For the Lord, Yahweh, rescues us from the ways of death many times.
68.21: But he will crush every enemy, shattering their strength. He will make heads roll for they refuse to repent of their stubborn, sinful ways.
68.22: I hear the Lord God saying to all the enemies of his people, “You’d better come out of your hiding places, all of you who are doing your best to stay far away from me. Don’t you know there’s no place to hide?
68.23: For my people will be the conquerors; they will soon have you under their feet. They will crush you until there is nothing left!”
68.24: O God, my King, your triumphal processions keep moving onward in holiness; you’re moving onward toward the Holy Place!
68.25: Leaders in front, then musicians, with young maidens in between, striking their tambourines.
68.26: And they sing, “Let all God’s princely people rejoice! Let all the congregations bring their blessing to God, saying, ‘The Lord of the fountain! The Lord of the fountain of life! The Lord of the fountain of Israel!’ ”
68.27: Astonishingly, it’s the favored youth leading the way: princes of praise in their royal robes and exalted princes are among them, along with princes who have wrestled with God.
68.28: Display your strength, God, and we’ll be strong! For your miracles have made us who we are. Lord, do it again and parade from your temple your mighty power. By your command even kings will bring gifts to you.
68.29: The kings of the earth are bringing tribute to your Temple in Jerusalem.
68.30: God, rebuke the beast-life that hides within us! Rebuke those who claim to be “strong ones,” who lurk within the congregation and abuse the people out of their love for money. God scatters the people who are spoiling for a fight.
68.31: Africa will send her noble envoys to you, O God. They will come running, stretching out their hands in love to you.
68.32: Let all the nations of the earth sing songs of praise to Almighty God! Go ahead, all you nations—sing your praise to the Lord!
68.33: Make music for the one who strides the ancient skies. Listen to his thunderous voice of might split open the heavens.
68.34: Give it up for God, for he alone has all the strength and power! Proclaim his majesty! For his glory shines down on Israel. His mighty strength soars in the clouds of glory.
68.35: God, we are consumed with awe, trembling before you as your glory streams from your Holy Place. The God of power shares his mighty strength with Israel and with all his people. God, we give our highest praise to you!

69.1: God, my God, come and save me! These floods of trouble have risen higher and higher. The water is up to my neck! I’m sinking into the mud with no place to stand, and I’m about to drown in this storm.
69.2: Deeper and deeper I sink into the mire; I can't find a foothold to stand on. I am in deep water, and the floods overwhelm me.
69.3: I’m weary, exhausted with weeping. My throat is dry, my voice is gone, my eyes are swollen with sorrow, and I’m waiting for you, God, to come through for me.
69.4: I can’t even count all those who hate me for no reason. Many influential men want me silenced, yet I’ve done nothing against them. Must I restore what I never took away?
69.5: God, my life is an open book to you. You know every sin I’ve ever done. For nothing within me is hidden from your sight!
69.6: Lord Yahweh of Angel Armies, keep me from ever being a stumbling block to others, to those who love you. Lord God of Israel, don’t let what happens to me be the source of confusion to those who are passionate for you.
69.7: Because of my love for you, Lord, I have been mocked, cursed, and disgraced.
69.8: Even my own brothers, those of my family, act as though they don’t want anything to do with me.
69.9: My love for you has my heart on fire! My passion for your house consumes me! Nothing will turn me away, even though I endure all the insults of those who insult you.
69.10: When they see me seeking for more of you with weeping and fasting, they all just scoff and scorn at my passion.
69.11: When I humble myself with sorrow over my sin, it gives them a reason to mock me even more.
