103.3: You kissed my heart with forgiveness, in spite of all I’ve done. You’ve healed me inside and out from every disease.
103.4: You’ve rescued me from hell and saved my life. You’ve crowned me with love and mercy.
103.5: You satisfy my every desire with good things. You’ve supercharged my life so that I soar again like a flying eagle in the sky!
103.6: You’re a God who makes things right, giving justice to the defenseless.
103.7: You unveiled to Moses your plans and showed Israel’s sons what you could do.
103.8: Lord, you’re so kind and tenderhearted and so patient with people who fail you! Your love is like a flooding river overflowing its banks with kindness.
103.9: You don’t look at us only to find our faults, just so that you can hold a grudge against us.
103.10: You may discipline us for our many sins, but never as much as we really deserve. Nor do you get even with us for what we’ve done.
103.11: Higher than the highest heavens— that’s how high your tender mercy extends! Greater than the grandeur of heaven above is the greatness of your loyal love, towering over all who fear you and bow down before you!
103.12: Farther than from a sunrise to a sunset— that’s how far you’ve removed our guilt from us.
103.13: The same way a loving father feels toward his children— that’s but a sample of your tender feelings toward us, your beloved children, who live in awe of you.
103.14: You know all about us, inside and out. You are mindful that we’re made from dust.
103.15: Our days are so few, and our momentary beauty so swiftly fades away!
103.16: Then all of a sudden we’re gone, like grass clippings blown away in a gust of wind, taken away to our appointment with death, leaving nothing to show that we were here.
103.17: But Lord, your endless love stretches from one eternity to the other, unbroken and unrelenting toward those who fear you and those who bow facedown in awe before you. Your faithfulness to keep every gracious promise you’ve made passes from parents, to children, to grandchildren, and beyond.
103.18: You are faithful to all those who follow your ways and keep your word.
103.19: Yahweh has established his throne in heaven; his kingdom rules the entire universe.
103.20: So bless the Lord, all his messengers of power, for you are his mighty heroes who listen intently to the voice of his word to do it.
103.21: Bless and praise the Lord, you mighty warriors, ministers who serve him well and fulfill his desires.
103.22: I will bless and praise the Lord with my whole heart! Let all his works throughout the earth, wherever his dominion stretches— let everything bless the Lord!

104.1: Everything I am will praise and bless the Lord! O Lord, my God, your greatness takes my breath away, overwhelming me by your majesty, beauty, and splendor!
104.2: You wrap yourself with a shimmering, glistening light. You wear sunshine like a garment of glory. You stretch out the starry skies like a tapestry.
104.3: You build your balconies with light beams and ride as King in a chariot you made from clouds. You fly upon the wings of the wind.
104.4: You make your messengers into winds of the Spirit, and all your ministers become flames of fire.
104.5: You, our Creator, formed the earth, and you hold it all together so it will never fall apart.
104.6: You poured the ocean depths over the planet, submerging mountains beneath.
104.7: Yet at the sound of your thunder-shout the waters all fled away, filling the deep with seas.
104.8: The mountains rose and valleys sank to the levels you decreed for them.
104.9: Then you set a boundary line for the seas and commanded them not to trespass.
104.10: You sent springs cascading through the valleys, flowing freely between the mountains and hills.
104.11: You provide drink for every living thing; men and beasts have their thirst quenched because of you.
104.12: The birds build nests near the tranquil streams, chirping their joyous songs from the branches above.
104.13: From your kindness you send the rain to water the mountains from the upper rooms of your palace. Your goodness brings forth fruit for all to enjoy.
104.14: Your compassion brings the earth’s harvest, feeding the hungry. You cause the grass to grow for livestock, along with the fruit, grains, and vegetables to feed mankind.
104.15: You provide sweet wine to gladden hearts. You give us daily bread to sustain life, giving us glowing health for our bodies.
104.16: The trees of the Lord drink until they’re satisfied. Lebanon’s lofty trees stand tall right where you planted them.
104.17: Within their branches you provide for birds a place to build their nests; even herons find a home in the cypress trees.
104.18: You make the high mountains a home for wild goats and the rocky crag where the rock badgers burrow.
104.19: You made the moon to mark the months and the sun to measure the days.
104.20: You turn off the light and it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest come out to prowl.
104.21: The mighty lions roar for their dinner, but it’s you, God, who feeds them all.
104.22: At sunrise they slink back to their dens to crouch down in the shadows.
104.23: Then man goes out to his labor and toil, working from dawn to dusk.
104.24: O Lord, what an amazing variety of all you have created! Wild and wonderful is this world you have made, while wisdom was there at your side. This world is full of so many creatures, yet each belongs to you!
104.25: And then there is the sea! So vast! So wide and deep— swarming with countless forms of sea life, both small and great.
104.26: Trading ships glide through the high seas. And look! There are the massive whales bounding upon the waves.
104.27: All the creatures wait expectantly for you to give them their food as you determine.
104.28: You come near and they all gather around, feasting from your open hands, and each is satisfied from your abundant supply.
104.29: But if you were to withhold from them and turn away, they all would panic. And when you choose to take away their breath, each one dies and returns to the dust.
104.30: When you release your Spirit-Wind, life is created, ready to replenish life upon the earth.
104.31: May God’s glorious splendor endure forever! May the Lord take joy and pleasure in all that he has made.
104.32: For the earth’s overseer has the power to make it tremble; just a touch of his finger and volcanoes erupt as the earth shakes and melts.
104.33: I will sing my song to the Lord as long as I live! Every day I will sing my praises to God.
104.34: May you be pleased with every sweet thought I have about you, for you are the source of my joy and gladness.
104.35: Now, let all the sinners be swept from the earth. But I will keep on praising you, my Lord, with all that is within me. My joyous, blissful shouts of “Hallelujah” are all because of you!

105.1: Go ahead and give God thanks for all the glorious things he has done! Go ahead and worship him! Tell everyone about his wonders!
105.2: Let’s sing his praises! Sing, and put all of his miracles to music!
105.3: Shine and make your joyful boast in him, you lovers of God. Let’s be happy and keep rejoicing no matter what.
105.4: Seek more of his strength! Seek more of him! Let’s always be seeking the light of his face.
105.5: Don’t you ever forget his miracles and marvels. Hold to your heart every judgment he has decreed.
105.6: For you are his servants, the true seed of Abraham, and you are the chosen ones, Jacob’s sons.
105.7: For he is the Lord our God, and his wise authority can be seen in all he does.
105.8: For though a thousand generations may pass away, he is still true to his word. He has kept every promise he made to Abraham and to Isaac.
105.9: This is the covenant he made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Isaac.
105.10: His promises have become an everlasting covenant to Jacob, as a decree to Jacob.
105.11: He said to them, “I will give you all the land of Canaan as your inheritance.”
105.12: They were very few in number when God gave them that promise, and they were all foreigners to that land.
105.13: They were wandering from one land to another and from one kingdom to another.
105.14: Yet God would not permit anyone to touch them, punishing even kings who came against them.
105.15: He said to them, “Don’t you dare lay a hand on my anointed ones, and don’t do a thing to hurt my prophets!”
105.16: So God decreed a famine upon Canaan-land, cutting off their food supply.
105.17: But he had already sent a man ahead of his people to Egypt; it was Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
105.18: His feet were bruised by strong shackles and his soul was held by iron.
105.19: God’s promise to Joseph purged his character until it was time for his dreams to come true.
105.20: Eventually, the king of Egypt sent for him, setting him free at last.
105.21: Then Joseph was put in charge of everything under the king; he became the master of the palace over all the royal possessions.
105.22: Pharoah gave him authority over all the princes of the land, and Joseph became the teacher of wisdom to the king’s advisers.
105.23: Then Jacob, with all of Joseph’s family, came from Canaan to Egypt and settled in Goshen.
105.24: God made them very fruitful, and they multiplied incredibly until they were greater in number than those who ruled them.
105.25: God turned their hearts to hate his people and to deal treacherously with his servants.
105.26: But he sent them his faithful servant, Moses, the deliverer, and chose Aaron to accompany him.
105.27: Their command brought down signs and wonders, working miracles in Egypt.
105.28: By God’s direction, they spoke and released a plague of thick darkness over the land.
105.29: God turned their rivers to blood, causing every fish to die.
105.30: And the judgment-plague of frogs came in enormous numbers, swarming everywhere, even into Pharaoh’s bedroom!
105.31: God spoke and another plague was released— massive swarms of flies, vast clouds of insects, covered the land.
105.32: God rained down hail and flaming fire upon Egypt.
105.33: Their gardens and vines were all destroyed, shattering trees into splinters throughout the territory.
105.34: God spoke, and devouring hordes of locusts swept over the land,
105.35: picking the ground clean of vegetation and crops.
105.36: Then God struck down their firstborn sons, the pride and joy of every Egyptian family.
105.37: At last, God freed all the Hebrews from their slavery and sent them away laden with the silver and gold of Egypt. And not even one was feeble on their way out!
105.38: Egypt was relieved at their exodus, ready to see them go, for the terror of the Lord of the Hebrews had fallen upon them!
105.39: God spread out a cloud as shade as they moved ahead and a cloud of fire to light up their night.
105.40: Moses prayed and God brought them quail to eat. He satisfied them with heaven’s bread falling from the sky.
105.41: He broke open the boulder and the waters poured out like a river in the desert.
105.42: For God could never forget his holy promise to his servant Abraham.
105.43: So God brought out his chosen ones with singing; with a joyful shout they were set free!
105.44: He gave them lands and nations, just like he promised. Fruitful lands of crops they had never planted were now theirs.
105.45: All this was done for them so that they would be faithful to keep the ways of God, obeying his laws and following his truths. Hallelujah! Praise the Lord!

106.1: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord! Everyone thank God, for he is good and easy to please. Your tender love for us, Lord, continues on forever.
106.2: Who could ever fully describe your glorious miracles? Yahweh, who could ever praise you enough?
106.3: The happiest one on earth is the one who keeps your word and clings to righteousness every moment.
106.4: So remember me, Lord, as you take joy in your people. And when you come to bring the blessings of salvation, don’t forget me!
106.5: Let me share in the wealth and beauty of all your devoted lovers, rejoice with your nation in all their joys, and let me share in the glory you give to your chosen ones.
106.6: We have all sinned so much, just like our fathers. “Guilty” is written over our lives.
106.7: Our fathers who were delivered from Egypt didn’t fully understand your wonders, and they took you for granted. Over and over you showed them such tender love and mercy! Yet they were barely beyond the Red Sea when they rebelled against you.
106.8: Nonetheless, you saved them more than once so they would know how powerful you are, showing them the honor of your name.
106.9: You roared over the waters of the Red Sea, making a dry path for your people to cross through.
106.10: You freed them from the strong power of those who oppressed them and rescued them from bondage.
106.11: Then the waters rushed over their enemies and drowned them all— not one survived.
106.12: Seeing this, the people believed your words, and they all broke out with songs of praise!
106.13: Yet how quickly they forgot your miracles of power. They wouldn’t wait for you to act when they were hungry,
106.14: but demanded you satisfy their cravings and give them food! They tested you to the breaking point.
106.15: So you gave them what they wanted to eat, but their souls starved away to nothing.
106.16: They became envious of Moses and Aaron, your holy ones.
106.17: You split open the earth, and it swallowed up Dathan and Abiram along with their followers.
106.18: Fire fell from heaven and burnt up all the band of rebels, turning them to ashes.
106.19: They made an idol of a calf at Sinai and bowed to worship their man-made statue.
106.20: They preferred the image of a grass-eating ox to the presence of the glory-filled God.
106.21: They totally forgot it was you who saved them by the wonders and awesome miracles you worked in Egypt.
106.22: such wonderful things in that land, such awesome deeds at the Red Sea.
106.23: So you decided to destroy them. But Moses, your chosen leader, stood in the gap between you and the people and made intercession on their behalf to turn away your wrath from killing them all.
106.24: Yet they still didn’t believe your words and they despised the land of delight you gave to them.
106.25: They grumbled and found fault with everything and closed their hearts to your voice.
106.26: So you solemnly swore to them that they would all die in the desert.
106.27: And you scattered their children to distant lands to die as exiles.
106.28: Then our fathers joined the worshipers of the false god named “Lord of the Pit.” They even ate the sacrifices offered to the dead!
106.29: All they did made you burn with anger. It made you so angry that a plague broke out among them!
106.30: It continued until Phineas intervened and executed the guilty for causing judgment to fall upon them.
106.31: Because of this deed of righteousness Phineas will be remembered forever.
106.32: Your people also provoked you to wrath at the stream called Strife. This is where Moses got into serious trouble!
106.33: Because the people were rebellious against you, Moses exploded in anger and spoke to them out of his bitterness.
106.34: Neither did our fathers destroy the enemies in the land, as you had commanded them.
106.35: But they mingled themselves with their enemies and learned to copy their works of darkness.
106.36: They began to serve their gods and bow before their idols. All of this led them away from you and brought about their downfall.
106.37: They even sacrificed their little children to the demon spirits,
106.38: shedding the innocent blood of their sons and daughters. These dark practices greatly defiled the land and their own souls, through the murder and bloodshed of their own babies! Their sins made them spiritual adulterers before you.
106.39: They defiled themselves by their evil deeds, and their love of idols was adultery in the LORD's sight.
106.40: This is why you were furious. As your anger burned hot against them, you couldn’t even stand to look at your very own people any longer!
106.41: So you turned them over to the crushing hands of other nations, and those who hated them became tyrants over them.
106.42: Oppressive enemies subdued them, ruling over them with their tyranny.
106.43: Many times you would have come to rescue them, but they continued in their rebellious ways, choosing to ignore your warnings. Then they sank lower and lower, destroyed by their depravity.
106.44: Yet even so, you waited and waited, watching to see if they would turn and cry out to you for a father’s help. And then, when you heard their cry, you relented and you remembered your covenant, and you turned your heart toward them again, according to your abundant, overflowing, and limitless love.
106.45: He remembered his covenant with them and relented because of his unfailing love.
106.46: Then you caused even their oppressors to pity them and show them compassion.
106.47: Do it again, Lord! Save us, O Lord, our God! Gather us from our exile and unite us together so that we will give our great and joyous thanks to you again and bring you glory by our praises.
106.48: Blessed be our Lord God forever and ever. And let everyone everywhere say, “Hallelujah!” Amen! Faithful is our King!

107.1: Let everyone give all their praise and thanks to the Lord! Here’s why—he’s better than anyone could ever imagine. Yes, he’s always loving and kind, and his faithful love never ends.
107.2: So, go ahead—let everyone know it! Tell the world how he broke through and delivered you from the power of darkness and has gathered us together from all over the world. He has set us free to be his very own!
107.3: For he has gathered the exiles from many lands, from east and west, from north and south.
107.4: Some of us once wandered in the wilderness like desert nomads, with no true direction or dwelling place.
107.5: Starving, thirsting, staggering, we became desperate and filled with despair.
107.6: Then we cried out, “Lord, help us! Rescue us!” And he did!
107.7: He led us out by the right way until we reached a suitable city to dwell in.
107.8: So lift your hands and thank God for his marvelous kindness and for all his miracles of mercy for those he loves.
107.9: How he satisfies the souls of thirsty ones and fills the hungry with goodness!
107.10: Some of us once sat in darkness, living in the dark shadows of death. We were prisoners to our pain, chained to our regrets.
107.11: For we rebelled against God’s Word and rejected the wise counsel of God Most High.
107.12: So he humbled us through our circumstances, watching us as we stumbled, with no one there to pick us back up. Our own pain became our punishment.
107.13: Then we cried out, “Lord, help us! Rescue us!” And he did!
107.14: His light broke through the darkness and he led us out in freedom from death’s dark shadow and snapped every one of our chains.
107.15: So lift your hands and give thanks to God for his marvelous kindness and for his miracles of mercy for those he loves!
107.16: For he smashed through heavy prison doors and shattered the steel bars that held us back, just to set us free!
107.17: Some of us were such fools, bringing on ourselves sorrow and suffering all because of our sins.
107.18: Sick and feeble, unable to stand the sight of food, we drew near to the gates of death.
107.19: Then we cried out, “Lord, help us! Rescue us!” And he did!
107.20: God spoke the words “Be healed,” and we were healed, delivered from death’s door!
107.21: So lift your hands and give thanks to God for his marvelous kindness and for his miracles of mercy for those he loves!
107.22: Bring your praise as an offering and your thanks as a sacrifice as you sing your story of miracles with a joyful song.
107.23: Some of us set sail upon the sea to faraway ports, transporting our goods from ship to shore.
107.24: We were witnesses of God’s power out in the ocean deep; we saw breathtaking wonders upon the high seas.
107.25: When God spoke he stirred up a storm, lifting high the waves with hurricane winds.
107.26: Ships were tossed by the swelling sea, rising to the sky, then dropping down to the depths, reeling like drunkards, spinning like tops, everyone at their wits’ end until even sailors despaired of life, cringing in terror.
107.27: They reeled and staggered like drunkards and were at their wits' end.
107.28: Then we cried out, “Lord, help us! Rescue us!” And he did!
107.29: God stilled the storm, calmed the waves, and he hushed the hurricane winds to only a whisper.
107.30: We were so relieved, so glad as he guided us safely to harbor in a quiet haven.
107.31: So lift your hands and give thanks to God for his marvelous kindness and for his miracles of mercy for those he loves!
107.32: Let’s exalt him on high and lift up our praises in public; let all the people and the leaders of the nation know how great and wonderful is Yahweh, our God!
107.33: Whenever he chooses he can dry up a river and turn the land into a desert.
107.34: Or he can take a fruitful land and make it into a saltwater swamp, all because of the wickedness of those who dwell there.
107.35: But he also can turn a barren wilderness into an oasis with water! He can make springs flow into desert lands
107.36: and turn them into fertile valleys so that cities spring up, and he gives it all to those who are hungry.
107.37: They can plant their fields and vineyards there and reap a bumper crop and gather a fruitful harvest.
107.38: God will bless them and cause them to multiply and prosper.
107.39: But others will become poor, humbled because of their oppression, tyranny, and sorrows.
107.40: For God pours contempt upon their arrogant abuse of power, heaping scorn upon their princes, and makes them wander among ruins.
107.41: But he raises up the poor and lowly with his favor, giving them a safe place to live where no one can touch them. God will grant them a large family and bless them!
107.42: The lovers of God will rejoice when they see this. Good men are glad when the evil ones are silenced.
107.43: If you are truly wise, you’ll learn from what I’ve told you. It’s time for you to consider these profound lessons of God’s great love and mercy!

108.1: My heart, O God, is focused and determined. Now I can sing my song with passionate praises! Awake, O my soul, with the music of his splendor.
108.2: Arise, my soul, and sing his praises! I will awaken the dawn with my worship, greeting the daybreak with my songs of light.
108.3: Wherever I go, I will thank you. All the nations will hear my praise songs to you.
108.4: Your love is so extravagant, it reaches higher than the heavens! Your faithfulness is so astonishing, it stretches to the skies!
108.5: Lord God, be exalted as you soar throughout the heavens. May your shining glory be seen high above all the earth!
108.6: Come to your beloved ones and gently draw us out. Answer our prayer for your saving help. Come with your might and strength, for we need you, Lord!
108.7: Then I heard the Lord speak in his holy splendor, and from his sanctuary I heard the Lord promise: “In my triumph I will be the one to measure out the portion of my inheritance to my people, and I will secure the land as I promised you. Shechem, Succoth, Gilead, Manasseh — they are all still mine!” he says. “Judah will continue to produce kings and lawgivers, and Ephraim will produce great warriors. Moab will become my lowly servant. Edom will likewise serve my purposes. I will lift up a shout of victory over the land of Philistia!
108.8: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim will produce my warriors, and Judah will produce my kings.
108.9: Moab will become my lowly servant, and Edom will be my slave. I will shout in triumph over the Philistines."
108.10: But who will bring my triumph into Edom’s fortresses?”
108.11: Lord, have you really rejected us, refusing to fight our battles?
108.12: Give us a father’s help when we face our enemies. For to trust in any man is an empty hope.
108.13: With God’s help we will prevail with might and power. And with God’s help we’ll trample down our every foe!

109.1: God of all my praise, don’t stand silently by, aloof to my pain,
109.2: while the wicked slander me with their lies. Even right in front of my face they lie through their teeth.
109.3: I’ve done nothing to them, but they still surround me with their venomous words of hatred and vitriol.
109.4: Though I love them, they stand accusing me like Satan for what I’ve never done. I will pray until I become prayer itself.
109.5: They continually repay me with evil when I show them good. They give me hatred when I show them love.
109.6: Show him how it feels! Let accusing liars be raised up against him, like Satan himself standing right next to him. And let him be declared guilty by a wicked judge. May even his prayers be seen as sinful!
109.7: When his case is called for judgment, let him be pronounced guilty. Count his prayers as sins.
109.8: Shorten his life and let another replace him!
109.9: Make his wife a widow and his children orphans!
109.10: Let them wander as beggars in the street, like homeless vagabonds, evicted from their ruins!
109.11: Let the creditors seize his entire estate, and strangers, like vultures, take all that’s left!
109.12: Let no one be kind to him by showing pity to his fatherless children!
109.13: May all his posterity die with him! Cut down his family tree!
109.14: And may all the sins of his ancestors be recorded, remembered before you, forever! Cut off even the memory of his family from the face of the earth,
109.15: May these sins always remain before the LORD, but may his name be cut off from human memory.
109.16: because he never once showed love or kindness to others, but persecuted the poor, the brokenhearted, and afflicted ones, even putting them to death!
109.17: Since he enjoyed cursing them, may all his curses now come raining back on him until it all overwhelms him with misfortune! Since he refused to bless others, God, withhold every single blessing from him!
109.18: Bitterness, such vile vindictiveness, was upon everything he did. Cursing was his lifestyle.
109.19: So smother him now with his own curses as his just reward. This will be the Lord’s punishment upon him and all my lying accusers who speak evil against me.
109.20: May those curses become the LORD's punishment for my accusers who are plotting against my life.
109.21: But now, O Yahweh -God, make yourself real to me like you promised me you would. Because of your constant love and your heart-melting kindness, come be my hero and deliver me!
109.22: I’m so broken, needy and hurting. My heart is pierced through and I’m so wounded.
109.23: I’m slipping down a dark slope, shaken to the core, and helpless.
109.24: All my fasting has left me so weak I can hardly stand. Now I’m shriveled up, nothing but skin and bones.
109.25: I’m the example of failure and shame to all who see me. They just walk by me, shaking their heads.
109.26: You have to help me, O Lord God! My true hero, come to my rescue and save me, for you are loving and kind.
109.27: Then everyone will know that you have won my victory, and they will all say to the Lord, “You have finished it!”
109.28: So let them curse me if they want, but I know you will bless me! All their efforts to destroy me will fail, but I will succeed and be glad.
109.29: So let my Satan-like accusers fail! Make them look ridiculous if they try to come against me. Clothe them with a robe of guilty shame from this day on!
109.30: But I will give my thanks to you over and over, and everyone will hear my lavish praises.
109.31: For you stand right next to the broken ones as their saving hero to rescue them from all their accusers!

110.1: Yahweh said to my Lord, the Messiah: “Sit with me as enthroned ruler while I subdue your every enemy. They will bow low before you as I make them a footstool for your feet.”
110.2: Messiah, I know God himself will establish your kingdom as you reign in Zion-glory. For he says to you, “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”
110.3: Your people will be your love offerings. In the day of your mighty power you will be exalted, and in the brightness of your holy ones you will shine as an army arising from the womb of the dawn, anointed with the dew of your youth!
110.4: Yahweh has taken a solemn oath and will never back away from it, saying, “You are a priest for eternity, after the manner of Melchizedek!”
110.5: The Lord stands in full authority to shatter to pieces the kings who stand against you on the day he displays his terrible wrath.
110.6: He will judge every rebellious nation, filling their battlefields with corpses, and will shatter the strongholds of ruling powers.
110.7: Yet he himself will drink from his inheritance as from a flowing brook; refreshed by love he will stand victorious!

111.1: Shout hallelujah to Yahweh! May every one of his devoted lovers hear my passionate praise to him, even among the council of the holy ones.
111.2: For God’s mighty miracles astound me! His wonders are so delightfully mysterious that they leave all who seek them astonished.
111.3: Everything he does is full of splendor and beauty! Each miracle demonstrates his eternal perfection.
111.4: His unforgettable works of surpassing wonder reveal his grace and tender mercy.
111.5: He satisfies all who love and trust him, and he keeps every promise he makes.
111.6: He reveals mighty power and marvels to his people by handing them nations as a gift.
111.7: All God accomplishes is flawless, faithful, and fair, and his every word proves trustworthy and true.
111.8: They are steadfast forever and ever, formed from truth and righteousness.
111.9: His forever-love paid a full ransom for his people so that now we’re free to come before Yahweh to worship his holy and awesome name!
111.10: Where can wisdom be found? It is born in the fear of God. Everyone who follows his ways will never lack his living-understanding. And the adoration of God will abide throughout eternity!

112.1: Shout in celebration of praise to the Lord! Everyone who loves the Lord and delights in him will cherish his words and be blessed beyond expectation.
112.2: Their descendants will be prosperous and influential. Every generation of the righteous will experience his favor.
112.3: Great blessing and wealth fills the house of the wise, for their integrity endures forever.
112.4: Even if darkness overtakes them, sunrise-brilliance will come bursting through because they are gracious to others, so tender and true.
112.5: Life is good for the one who is generous and charitable, conducting affairs with honesty and truth.
112.6: Their circumstances will never shake them and others will never forget their example.
112.7: They will not live in fear or dread of what may come, for their hearts are firm, ever secure in their faith.
112.8: Steady and strong, they will not be afraid, but will calmly face their every foe until they all go down in defeat.
112.9: Never stingy and always generous to those in need, they lived lives of influence and honor that will never be forgotten, for they were full of good deeds.
112.10: But the wicked take one look at a life lived like this and they grit their teeth in anger, not understanding their bliss. The wicked slink away speechless in the darkness that falls, where hope dies and all their dreams fade away to nothing, nothing at all!

113.1: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord! Go ahead, praise the Lord, all you loving servants of God! Keep it up! Praise him some more!
113.2: For the glorious name of the Lord is blessed forever and ever.
113.3: From sunrise-brilliance to sunset-beauty, lift up his praise from dawn to dusk!
113.4: For he rules on high over the nations with a glory that outshines even the heavens.
113.5: No one can be compared to God, enthroned on high!
113.6: He stoops down to look upon the sky and the earth.
113.7: He promotes the poor, picking them up from the dirt, and rescues the needy from the garbage dump.
113.8: He turns paupers into princes and seats them on their royal thrones of honor.
113.9: God’s grace provides for the barren ones a joyful home with children so that even childless couples find a family. He makes them happy parents surrounded by their pride and joy. That’s the God we praise, so give it all to him!

114.1: Many years ago the Jewish people escaped Egypt’s tyranny,
114.2: so that Israel, God’s people of praise, would become his holy sanctuary, his kingdom on the earth.
114.3: The Red Sea waters saw them coming and ran the other way! Then later, the Jordan River too moved aside so that they could all pass through.
114.4: The land shuddered with fear. Mountains and hills shook with dread.
114.5: O sea, what happened to you to make you flee? O Jordan, what was it that made you turn and run?
114.6: O mountains, what frightened you so? And you hills, what made you shiver?
114.7: Tremble, O earth, for you are in the presence of the Lord, the presence of the God of Jacob.
114.8: He splits open boulders and brings up bubbling water. Gushing streams burst forth when he is near!

115.1: God, glorify your name! Yes, your name alone be glorified, not ours. For you are the one who loves us passionately, and you are faithful and true.
115.2: Why should the unbelievers mock us, saying, “Where is this God of yours?”
115.3: But we know our God rules from the heavens, and he takes delight in all that he does.
115.4: The unbelievers worship what they make— their wealth and their work.
115.5: They idolize what they own and what they make with their hands, but their things can’t talk to them or answer their prayers. Their possessions will never satisfy. Their futile faith in dead idols and dead works can never bring life or meaning to their souls. Blind men can only create blind things. Those deaf to God can only make a deaf image. Dead men can only create dead idols. And everyone who trusts in these powerless, dead things will be just like what they worship—powerless and dead.
115.6: They cannot hear with their ears, or smell with their noses,
115.7: or feel with their hands, or walk with their feet, or utter sounds with their throats!
115.8: And those who make them are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
115.9: So trust in the Lord, all his people. For he is the only true hero, the wraparound God who is our shield!
115.10: You, his priests, trust in the Lord. For he is the only true hero, God-wrapped-around-us as our shield.
115.11: Yes, all his lovers who bow before him, trust in the Lord. For he is our only true hero, God-wrapped-around-us as our shield.
115.12: The Lord will never forget us in our need; he will bless us indeed! He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron, his priest.
115.13: Yes! He will bless his devoted lovers who bow before him, no matter who they are.
115.14: God himself will fill you with more. Blessings upon blessings will be heaped upon you and upon your children from the maker of heaven and earth, the very God who made you!
115.15: May you be blessed by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
115.16: The heavens belong to our God; they are his alone, but he has given us the earth and put us in charge.
115.17: Dead people cannot praise the Lord, but we can! Those who sink to the silence of the grave can no longer give glory to God, but we can! So let’s praise the Lord and let it go on forever. Hallelujah, and praise the Lord!
115.18: But we can praise the LORD both now and forever! Praise the LORD!

116.1: I am passionately in love with God because he listens to me. He hears my prayers and answers them.
116.2: As long as I live I’ll keep praying to him, for he stoops down to listen to my heart’s cry.
116.3: Death once stared me in the face, and I was close to slipping into its dark shadows. I was terrified and overcome with sorrow.
116.4: I cried out to the Lord, “God, come and save me!”
116.5: He was so kind, so gracious to me. Because of his passion toward me, he made everything right and he restored me.
116.6: So I’ve learned from my experience that God protects the vulnerable. For I was broken and brought low, but he answered me and came to my rescue!
116.7: Now I can say to myself and to all, “Relax and rest, be confident and serene, for the Lord rewards fully those who simply trust in him.”
116.8: God has rescued my soul from death’s fear and dried my eyes of many tears. He’s kept my feet firmly on his path
116.9: and strengthened me so that I may please him and walk before Yahweh in his fields of life.
116.10: Even when it seems I’m surrounded by many liars and my own fears, and though I’m hurting in my suffering and trauma, I still stay faithful to God and speak words of faith.
116.11: In my anxiety I cried out to you, "These people are all liars!"
116.12: So now, what can I ever give back to God to repay him for the blessings he’s poured out on me?
116.13: I will lift up his cup of salvation and praise him extravagantly for all that he’s done for me.
116.14: I will fulfill the promise I made to God in the presence of his gathered people.
116.15: When one of God’s holy lovers dies, it is costly to the Lord, touching his heart.
116.16: Lord, because I am your loving servant, you have broken open my life and freed me from my chains.
116.17: Now I’ll worship you passionately and bring to you my sacrifice of praise, drenched with thanksgiving!
116.18: I’ll keep my promise to you, God, in the presence of your gathered people, just like I said I would.
116.19: I will worship you here in your living presence, in the temple in Jerusalem. I will worship and sing hallelujah, for I praise you, Lord!

117.1: Let everyone everywhere shine with praise to Yahweh! Let it all out! Go ahead and praise him!
117.2: For he has conquered us with his great love, and his kindness has melted our hearts. His faithfulness lasts forever, and he will never fail you. So go ahead, let it all out! Praise Yah! O Yah!

118.1: Keep on giving your thanks to God, for he is so good! His constant, tender love lasts forever!
118.2: Let all his princely people sing, “His constant, tender love lasts forever!”
118.3: Let all his holy priests sing, “His constant, tender love lasts forever!”
118.4: Let all his lovers who bow low before him sing, “His constant, tender love lasts forever!”
118.5: Out of my deep anguish and pain I prayed, and God, you helped me as a father. You came to my rescue and broke open the way into a beautiful and broad place.
118.6: Now I know, Lord, that you are for me, and I will never fear what man can do to me.
118.7: For you stand beside me as my hero who rescues me. I’ve seen with my own eyes the defeat of my enemies. I’ve triumphed over them all!
118.8: Lord, it is so much better to trust in you to save me than to put my confidence in someone else.
118.9: Yes, it is so much better to trust in the Lord to save me than to put my confidence in celebrities.
118.10: Once I was hemmed in and surrounded by those who don’t love you. But by Yahweh ’s supernatural power I overcame them all!
118.11: Yes, they surrounded me, like a swarm of killer bees swirling around me. I was trapped like one trapped by a raging fire; I was surrounded with no way out and at the point of collapse. But by Yahweh ’s supernatural power, I overcame them all!
118.12: They swarmed around me like bees; they blazed against me like a roaring flame. But I destroyed them all in the name of the LORD.
118.13: They pushed me right up to the edge, and I was ready to fall, but you helped me to triumph, and together we overcame them all.
118.14: Lord, you are my true strength and my glory-song, my champion, my Savior!
118.15: The joyful songs I now sing will be sung again in the hearts and homes of all your devoted lovers. My loud shouts of victory will echo throughout the land. For Yahweh ’s right hand conquers valiantly!
118.16: The right hand of Yahweh exalts! The right hand of Yahweh will never fail.
118.17: You will not let them kill me, but I will live to tell the world what the Lord has done for me.
118.18: Yes, the Lord punished me as I deserved, but he’ll never give me over to death.
118.19: Swing wide, you gates of righteousness, and let me pass through, and I will enter into God’s presence to worship only him.
118.20: I have found the gateway to God, the pathway to his presence for all his devoted lovers.
118.21: I will offer all my loving praise to you, and I thank you so much for answering my prayer and bringing me salvation!
118.22: The very stone the masons rejected as flawed has turned out to be the most important capstone of the arch, holding up the very house of God.
118.23: The Lord himself is the one who has done this, and it’s so amazing, so marvelous to see!
118.24: This is the very day of the Lord that brings gladness and joy, filling our hearts with glee.
118.25: O God, please come and save us again; bring us your breakthrough-victory!
118.26: Blessed is this one who comes to us, the sent one of the Lord. And from within the temple we cry, “We bless you!”
118.27: For the Lord our God has brought us his glory-light. I offer him my life in joyous sacrifice. Tied tightly to your altar, I will bring you praise. For you are the God of my life and I lift you high, exalting you to the highest place.
118.28: You are my God, and I will praise you! You are my God, and I will exalt you!
118.29: So let’s keep on giving our thanks to God, for he is so good! His constant, tender love lasts forever!

119.1: You’re only truly happy when you walk in total integrity, walking in the light of God’s Word.
119.2: What joy overwhelms everyone who keeps the ways of God, those who seek him as their heart’s passion!
119.3: They’ll never do what’s wrong but will always choose the paths of the Lord.
119.4: God has prescribed the right way to live: obeying his laws with all our hearts.
119.5: How I long for my life to bring you glory as I follow each and every one of your holy precepts!
119.6: Then I’ll never be ashamed, for I take strength from all your commandments.
119.7: I will give my thanks to you from a heart of love and truth. And every time I learn more of your righteous judgments,
119.8: I will be faithful to all that your Word reveals— so don’t ever give up on me!
119.9: How can a young man stay pure? Only by living in the Word of God and walking in its truth.
119.10: I have longed for you with the passion of my heart; don’t let me stray from your directions!
119.11: I consider your Word to be my greatest treasure, and I treasure it in my heart to keep me from committing sin’s treason against you.
119.12: My wonderful God, you are to be praised above all; teach me the power of your decrees!
119.13: I speak continually of your laws as I recite out loud your counsel to me.
119.14: I find more joy in following what you tell me to do than in chasing after all the wealth of the world.
119.15: I set my heart on your precepts and pay close attention to all your ways.
119.16: My delight is found in all your laws, and I won’t forget to walk in your words.
119.17: Let me, your servant, walk in abundance of life that I may always live to obey your truth.
119.18: Open my eyes to see the miracle-wonders hidden in Scripture.
119.19: My life on earth is so brief, so tutor me in the ways of your wisdom.
119.20: I am continually consumed by these irresistible longings, these cravings to obey your every commandment!
119.21: Your displeasure rests with those who are arrogant, who think they know everything; you rebuke the rebellious who refuse your laws.
119.22: Don’t let them mock and scorn me for obeying you.
119.23: For even if the princes and my leaders choose to criticize me, I will continue to serve you and walk in your plans for my life.
119.24: Your commandments are my counselors; your Word is my light and delight!
119.25: Lord, I’m fading away. I’m discouraged and lying in the dust; revive me by your word, just like you promised you would.
119.26: I’ve poured out my life before you, and you’ve always been there for me. So now I ask: teach me more of your holy decrees.
119.27: Open up my understanding to the ways of your wisdom, and I will meditate deeply on your splendor and your wonders.
119.28: My life’s strength melts away with grief and sadness; come strengthen me and encourage me with your words.
119.29: Keep me far away from what is false; give me grace to stay true to your laws.
119.30: I’ve chosen to obey your truth and walk in the splendor-light of all that you teach me.
119.31: Lord, don’t allow me to make a mess of my life, for I cling to your commands and follow them as closely as I can.
119.32: I will run after you with delight in my heart, for you will make me obedient to your instructions.
119.33: Give me revelation about the meaning of your ways so I can enjoy the reward of following them fully.
119.34: Give me an understanding heart so that I can passionately know and obey your truth.
119.35: Guide me into the paths that please you, for I take delight in all that you say.
119.36: Cause my heart to bow before your words of wisdom and not to the wealth of this world.
119.37: Help me turn my eyes away from illusions so that I pursue only that which is true; drench my soul with life as I walk in your paths.
119.38: Reassure me of your promises, for I am your beloved, your servant who bows before you.
119.39: Defend me from the criticism I face for keeping your beautiful words.
119.40: See how I long with cravings for more of your ways? Let your righteousness revive my spirit!
119.41: May your tender love overwhelm me, O Lord, for you are my Savior and you keep your promises.
119.42: I’ll always have an answer for those who mock me because I trust in your word.
119.43: May I never forget your truth, for I rely upon your precepts.
119.44: I will observe your laws every moment of the day and will never forget the words you say.
119.45: I will walk with you in complete freedom, for I seek to follow your every command.
119.46: When I stand before kings, I will tell them the truth and will never be ashamed.
119.47: My passion and delight is in your word, for I love what you say to me!
119.48: I long for more revelation of your truth, for I love the light of your word as I meditate on your decrees.
119.49: Lord, never forget the promises you’ve made to me, for they are my hope and confidence.
119.50: In all of my affliction I find great comfort in your promises, for they have kept me alive!
119.51: No matter how bitterly the proud mockers speak against me, I refuse to budge from your precepts.
119.52: Your revelation-light is eternal; I’m encouraged every time I think about your truth!
119.53: Whenever I see the wicked breaking your laws, I feel horrible.
119.54: As I journey through life, I put all your statutes to music; they become the theme of my joyous songs.
119.55: Throughout the night I think of you, dear God; I treasure your every word to me.
119.56: All this joy is mine as I follow your ways!
119.57: You are my satisfaction, Lord, and all that I need, so I’m determined to do everything you say.
119.58: With all my heart I seek your favor; pour out your grace on me as you promised!
119.59: When I realize that I’m going astray, I turn back to obey your instructions.
119.60: I give my all to follow your revelation-light; I will not delay to obey.
119.61: Even when temptations encircle me with evil, I won’t forget for a moment to follow your commands.
119.62: In the middle of the night I awake to give thanks to you because of all your revelation-light—so right and true!
119.63: Anyone who loves you and bows in obedience to your words will be my friend.
119.64: Give me more revelation of your ways, for I see your love and tender care everywhere.
119.65: Your extravagant kindness to me makes me want to follow your words even more!
119.66: Teach me how to make good decisions, and give me revelation-light, for I believe in your commands.
119.67: Before I was humbled I used to always wander astray, but now I see the wisdom of your words.
119.68: Everything you do is beautiful, flowing from your goodness; teach me the power of your wonderful words!
119.69: Proud boasters make up lies about me because I am passionate to follow all that you say.
119.70: Their hearts are dull and void of feelings, but I find my true treasure in your truth.
119.71: The punishment you brought me through was the best thing that could have happened to me, for it taught me your ways.
119.72: The words you speak to me are worth more than all the riches and wealth in the whole world!
119.73: Your very hands have held me and made me who I am; give me more revelation-light so I may learn to please you more.
119.74: May all your devoted lovers see how you treat me and be glad, for your words are entwined with my heart.
119.75: Lord, I know that your judgments are always right. Even when it’s me you judge, you’re still faithful and true.
119.76: Send your kind mercy-kiss to comfort me, your servant, just like you promised you would.
119.77: Love me tenderly so I can go on, for I delight in your life-giving truth.
119.78: Shame upon the proud liars! See how they oppress me, all because of my passion for your precepts!
119.79: May all your devoted lovers follow me as I follow the path of your instruction.
119.80: Make me passionate and wholehearted to fulfill your every wish, so that I’ll never have to be ashamed of myself.
119.81: I’m lovesick with yearnings for more of your salvation, for my heart is entwined with your Word.
119.82: I’m consumed with longings for your promises, so I ask, “When will they all come true?”
119.83: My soul feels dry and shriveled, useless and forgotten, but I will never forget your living truth.
119.84: How much longer must I wait until you punish my persecutors? For I am your loving servant.
119.85: Arrogant men who hate your truth and never obey your laws have laid a trap for my life.
119.86: They don’t know that everything you say is true, so they harass me with their lies. Help me, Lord!
119.87: They’ve nearly destroyed my life, but I refuse to yield; I still live according to your Word.
119.88: Revive me with your tender love and spare my life by your kindness, and I will continue to obey you.
119.89: Standing firm in the heavens and fastened to eternity is the Word of God.
119.90: Your faithfulness flows from one generation to the next; all that you created sits firmly in place to testify of you.
119.91: By your decree everything stands at attention, for all that you have made serves you.
119.92: Because your words are my deepest delight, I didn’t give up when all else was lost.
119.93: I can never forget the profound revelations you’ve taught me, for they have kept me alive more than once.
119.94: Lord, I’m all yours, and you are my Savior; I have sought to live my life pleasing to you.
119.95: Even though evil men wait in ambush to kill me, I will set my heart before you to understand more of your ways.
119.96: I’ve learned that there is nothing perfect in this imperfect world except your words, for they bring such fantastic freedom into my life!
119.97: O how I love and treasure your law; throughout the day I fill my heart with its light!
119.98: By considering your commands I have an edge over my enemies, for I take seriously everything you say.
119.99: You have given me more understanding than those who teach me, for I’ve absorbed your eye-opening revelation.
119.100: You have graced me with more insight than the old sages because I have not failed to walk in the light of your ways.
119.101: I refused to bend my morals when temptation was before me so that I could become obedient to your Word.
119.102: I refuse to turn away from difficult truths, for you yourself have taught me to love your words.
119.103: How sweet are your living promises to me; sweeter than honey is your revelation-light.
119.104: For your truth is the source of my understanding, not the falsehoods of those who don’t know you, which I despise.
119.105: Truth’s shining light guides me in my choices and decisions; the revelation of your Word makes my pathway clear.
119.106: To live my life by your righteous rules has been my holy and lifelong commitment.
119.107: I’m bruised and broken, overwhelmed by it all; breathe life into me again by your living word.
119.108: Lord, receive my grateful thanks and teach me more of how to please you.
119.109: Even though my life hangs in the balance, I’ll keep following what you’ve taught me, no matter what.
119.110: The ungodly have done their best to throw me off track, but I’ll not deviate from what you’ve told me to do.
119.111: Everything you speak to me is like joyous treasure, filling my life with gladness.
119.112: I have determined in my heart to obey whatever you say, fully and forever!
119.113: I despise those who can’t keep commitments, for I passionately love your revelation-light!
119.114: You’re my place of quiet retreat, and your wraparound presence becomes my shield as I wrap myself in your Word!
119.115: Go away! Leave me, all you workers of wickedness, for you can’t stop me from following every command of my God.
119.116: Lord, strengthen my inner being by the promises of your Word so that I may live faithful and unashamed for you.
119.117: Lift me up and I will be safe. Empower me to live every moment in the light of your ways.
119.118: Lord, you reject those who reject your laws, for they fool no one but themselves!
119.119: The wicked are thrown away, discarded and valueless. That’s why I will keep loving all of your laws!
119.120: My body trembles in holy awe of you, leaving me speechless, for I’m frightened of your righteous judgments.
119.121: Don’t leave me to the mercies of those who hate me, for I live to do what is just and fair.
119.122: Let me hear your promise of blessing over my life, breaking me free from the proud oppressors.
119.123: As a lovesick lover, I yearn for more of your salvation and for your virtuous promises.
119.124: Let me feel your tender love, for I am yours. Give me more understanding of your wonderful ways.
119.125: I need more revelation from your Word to know more about you, for I’m in love with you!
119.126: Lord, the time has come for you to break through, for evil men keep breaking your laws.
119.127: Truly, your message of truth means more to me than a vault filled with the purest gold.
119.128: Every word you speak, every truth revealed, is always right and beautiful to me, for I hate what is phony or false.
119.129: Your marvelous words are living miracles; no wonder I long to obey everything you say.
119.130: Break open your Word within me until revelation-light shines out! Those with open hearts are given insight into your plans.
119.131: I open my mouth and inhale the Word of God because I crave the revelation of your commands.
119.132: Turn your heart to me, Lord, and show me your grace like you do to every one of your godly lovers.
119.133: Prepare before me a path filled with your promises, and don’t allow even one sin to have dominion over me.
119.134: Rescue me from the oppression of ungodly men so that I can keep all your precepts.
119.135: Smile on me, your loving servant. Instruct me in what is right in your eyes.
119.136: When I witness the rebellious breaking your laws, it makes me weep uncontrollably!
119.137: Lord, your judgments reveal your righteousness, and your verdicts are always fair.
119.138: The motive behind your every word is pure, and your teachings are remarkably faithful and true.
119.139: I’ve been consumed with a furious passion to do what’s right, all because of the way my enemies disrespect your laws.
119.140: All your promises glow with fire; that’s why I’m a lover of your Word.
119.141: Even though I’m considered insignificant and despised by the world, I’ll never abandon your ways.
119.142: Your righteousness has no end; it is everlasting, and your rules are perfectly fair.
119.143: Even though my troubles overwhelm me with anguish, I still delight and cherish every message you speak to me.
119.144: Give me more revelation so that I can live for you, for nothing is more pure and eternal than your truth.
119.145: Answer my passionate prayer, O Lord, and I’ll obey everything you say.
119.146: Save me, God, and I’ll follow your every instruction.
119.147: Before the day dawns, I’ll be crying out for help and wrapping your words into my life.
119.148: I lie awake every night pondering your promises to me.
119.149: Lord, listen to my heart’s cry, for I know your love is real for me; breathe life into me again by the revelation of your justice.
119.150: Here they come—these lawless rebels are coming near, but they are all so far away from your laws.
119.151: God, you are near me always, so close to me; every one of your commands reveals truth.
119.152: I’ve known all along how true and unchanging is every word you speak, established forever!
119.153: Look upon all my misery and come be my hero to rescue me, for I will never forget what you’ve revealed to me.
119.154: Take my side and defend me in these sufferings; redeem me and revive me, just like you promised you would.
119.155: The wicked are so far from salvation, for they could not care less about your message of truth.
119.156: Your tender mercies are what I need, O God; give me back my life again through the revelation of your judgments.
119.157: I have so many enemies who persecute me, yet I won’t swerve from following your ways.
119.158: I grieve when I see how the faithless ones live, for they just walk away from your promises.
119.159: Lord, see how much I truly love your instructions. So in your tender kindness, breathe life into me again.
119.160: The sum total of all your words adds up to absolute truth, and every one of your righteous decrees is everlasting.
119.161: The powerful elite have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart trembles in awe because of your miracle-words.
119.162: Your promises are the source of my bubbling joy; the revelation of your Word thrills me like one who has discovered hidden treasure.
119.163: I despise every lie and hate every falsehood, for I am passionate about keeping your precepts.
119.164: I stop to praise you seven times a day, all because your ways are perfect!
119.165: There is such a great peace and well-being that comes to the lovers of your Word, and they will never be offended.
119.166: Lord, I’m longing for more of your salvation, for I want to do what pleases you.
119.167: My love for your ways is indescribable; in my innermost being I want to follow them perfectly!
119.168: I will keep your instructions and follow your counsel; all my ways are an open book before you.
119.169: Lord, listen to my prayer. It’s like a sacrifice I bring to you; I must have more revelation of your Word!
119.170: Take my words to heart when I ask you, Lord; rescue me, just like you promised!
119.171: I offer you my joyous praise for all that you’ve taught me.
119.172: Your wonderful words will become my song of worship, for everything you’ve commanded is perfect and true.
119.173: Place your hands of strength and favor upon me, for I’ve made my choice to follow your ways.
119.174: I wait for your deliverance, O Lord, for your words thrill me like nothing else!
119.175: Invigorate my life so that I can praise you even more, and may your truth be my strength!
119.176: I’ll never forget what you’ve taught me, Lord, but when I wander off and lose my way, come after me, for I am your beloved!

120.1: I was desperate for you to help me in my struggles, and you did!
120.2: So come and deliver me now from this treachery and false accusation.
120.3: O lying deceivers, don’t you know what is your fate?
120.4: You will be pierced through with condemnation and consumed with burning coals of fire!
120.5: Why am I doomed to live as an alien, scattered among these cruel savages? Am I destined to dwell in the darkened tents of desert nomads?
120.6: For too long I’ve had to live among those who hate peace.
120.7: I speak words of peace while they speak words of war, but they refuse to listen.

121.1: I look up to the mountains and hills, longing for God’s help. But then I realize that our true help and protection is only from the Lord, our Creator who made the heavens and the earth.
121.2: My help comes from the LORD, who made the heavens and the earth!
121.3: He will guard and guide me, never letting me stumble or fall. God is my keeper; he will never forget nor ignore me.
121.4: He will never slumber nor sleep; he is the Guardian-God for his people, Israel.
121.5: Yahweh himself will watch over you; he’s always at your side to shelter you safely in his presence.
121.6: He’s protecting you from all danger both day and night.
121.7: He will keep you from every form of evil or calamity as he continuously watches over you.
121.8: You will be guarded by God himself. You will be safe when you leave your home, and safely you will return. He will protect you now, and he’ll protect you forevermore!

122.1: I was overjoyed when they said, “Let’s go up to the house of the Lord.”
122.2: And now at last we stand here, inside the very gates of Jerusalem!
122.3: O Jerusalem, you were built as a city of praise, where God and man mingle together.
122.4: This is where all the tribes of Yahweh are required to come and worship him.
122.5: This is where the thrones of kings have been established to rule in righteousness; even King David ruled from here.
122.6: Pray and seek for Jerusalem’s peace, for all who love her will prosper!
122.7: O Jerusalem, may there be peace for those who dwell inside your walls and prosperity in your every palace.
122.8: I intercede for the sake of my family and friends who dwell there, that they may all live in peace.
122.9: For the sake of your house, Yahweh our God, I will seek the welfare and prosperity of Jerusalem.

123.1: O God-Enthroned in heaven, I lift my eyes toward you in worship.
123.2: The way I love you is like the way a servant wants to please his master, the way a maid waits for the orders of her mistress. We look to you, our God, with passionate longing to please you and discover more of your mercy and grace.
123.3: For we’ve had more than our fill of this scoffing and scorn— this mistreatment by the wealthy elite. Lord, show us your mercy! Lord, show us your grace!
123.4: We have had our fill of the scoffing of the proud and the contempt of the arrogant.

124.1: What if God had not been on our side? Let all Israel admit this!
124.2: What if God had not been there for us? Our enemies, in their violent anger, would have swallowed us up alive!
124.3: they would have swallowed us alive because of their burning anger against us.
124.4: The nations, with their flood of rage, would have swept us away, and we would have drowned and perished beneath their torrent of terror!
124.5: Yes, the raging waters of their fury would have overwhelmed our very lives.
124.6: We can praise God over and over that he never left us! God wouldn’t allow the terror of our enemies to defeat us.
124.7: We are free from the hunter’s trap; their snare is broken and we have escaped!
124.8: For the same God who made everything, our Creator and our mighty maker, he himself is our helper and defender!

125.1: Those who trust in the Lord are as unshakable, as unmovable as mighty Mount Zion!
125.2: Just as the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord’s wraparound presence surrounds his people, protecting them now and forever.
125.3: The wicked will not always rule over the godly, provoking them to do what is evil.
125.4: God, let your goodness be given away to your good people, to all your righteous ones!
125.5: But those who turn away from truth— them you will turn away from you, to follow their crooked ways. You will give them just what they deserve. May Israel experience peace and prosperity!

126.1: It was like a dream come true when you freed us from our bondage and brought us back to Zion!
126.2: We laughed and laughed and overflowed with gladness. We were left shouting for joy and singing your praise. All the nations saw it and joined in, saying, “The Lord has done great miracles for them!”
126.3: Yes, he did mighty miracles and we are overjoyed!
126.4: Now, Lord, do it again! Restore us to our former glory! May streams of your refreshing flow over us until our dry hearts are drenched again.
126.5: Those who sow their tears as seeds will reap a harvest with joyful shouts of glee.
126.6: They may weep as they go out carrying their seed to sow, but they will return with joyful laughter and shouting with gladness as they bring back armloads of blessing and a harvest overflowing!

127.1: If God’s grace doesn’t help the builders, they will labor in vain to build a house. If God’s mercy doesn’t protect the city, all the sentries will circle it in vain.
127.2: It really is senseless to work so hard from early morning till late at night, toiling to make a living for fear of not having enough. God can provide for his devoted lovers even while they sleep!
127.3: Children are God’s love-gift; they are heaven’s generous reward.
127.4: Children born to a young couple will one day rise to protect and provide for their parents.
127.5: Happy will be the couple who has many of them! A household full of children will not bring shame on your name but victory when you face your enemies, for your offspring will have influence and honor to prevail on your behalf!

128.1: How joyous are those who love the Lord and bow low before God, ready to obey him!
128.2: Your reward will be prosperity, happiness, and well-being.
128.3: Your wife will bless your heart and home. Your children will bring you joy as they gather around your table.
128.4: Yes, this is God’s generous reward for those who love him.
128.5: May the Lord bless you out of his Zion-glory! May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem throughout your lifetime.
128.6: And may you be surrounded by your grandchildren. Happiness to you! And happiness to Israel!

129.1: Let all Israel admit it. From our very beginning we have been persecuted by the nations.
129.2: And from our very beginning we have faced never-ending discrimination. Nevertheless, our enemies have not defeated us. We’re still here!
129.3: They have hurt us more than can be expressed, ripping us to shreds, cutting deeply into our souls.
129.4: But no matter what, the Lord is good to us. He is a righteous God who stood to defend us, breaking the chains of the evil ones that bound us.
129.5: May all who hate the Jews fall back in disgrace to a shameful defeat!
129.6: Let them be like grass planted in shallow soil that soon withers with no sustenance.
129.7: Let them be like weeds ignored by the reaper and worthless to the harvester.
129.8: Let no one who sees them say, “May the blessings of Yahweh be upon your life. May the Lord bless you.”

130.1: Lord, I cry out to you out of the depths of my despair!
130.2: Hear my voice, O God! Answer this prayer and hear my plea for mercy.
130.3: Lord, if you measured us and marked us with our sins, who would ever have their prayers answered?
130.4: But your forgiving love is what makes you so wonderful. No wonder you are loved and worshiped!
130.5: This is why I wait upon you, expecting your breakthrough, for your Word brings me hope.
130.6: I long for you more than any watchman would long for the morning light. I will watch and wait for you, O God, throughout the night.
130.7: O Israel, keep hoping, keep trusting, and keep waiting on the Lord, for he is tenderhearted, kind, and forgiving. He has a thousand ways to set you free!
130.8: He himself will redeem you; he will ransom you from the cruel slavery of your sins!

131.1: Lord, my heart is meek before you. I don’t consider myself better than others. I’m content to not pursue matters that are over my head— such as your complex mysteries and wonders— that I’m not yet ready to understand.
131.2: I am humbled and quieted in your presence. Like a contented child who rests on its mother’s lap, I’m your resting child and my soul is content in you.
131.3: O people of God, your time has come to quietly trust, waiting upon the Lord now and forever.

132.1: Lord, please don’t forget all the hardships David had to pass through.
132.2: And how he promised you, Jacob’s mighty God, saying,
132.3: “I will not cross the threshold of my own home to sleep in my own bed.
132.4: I will not sleep or slumber, nor even take time to close my eyes in rest,
132.5: until I find a place for you to dwell, O mighty God of Jacob. I devote myself to finding a resting place for you!”
132.6: First we heard that the ark was at Bethlehem. Then we found it in the forest of Kiriath-Jearim.
132.7: Let’s go into God’s dwelling place and bow down and worship before him.
132.8: Arise, O Lord, and enter your resting place, both you and the ark of your glorious strength!
132.9: May your priests wear the robes of righteousness, and let all your godly lovers sing for joy!
132.10: Don’t forsake your anointed king now, but honor your servant David.
132.11: For you gave your word and promised David in an unbreakable oath that one of his sons would be sitting on the throne to succeed him as king.
132.12: You also promised that if David’s sons would be faithful to keep their promise to follow you, obeying the words you spoke to them, then David’s dynasty would never end.
132.13: Lord, you have chosen Zion as your dwelling place, for your pleasure is fulfilled in making it your home.
132.14: I hear you say, “I will make this place my eternal dwelling, for I have loved and desired it as my very own!
132.15: I will make Zion prosper and satisfy her poor with my provision.
132.16: I will cover my priests with salvation’s power, and all my righteous ones will shout for joy!
132.17: I will increase the anointing that was upon David, and my glistening glory will rest upon my anointed one.
132.18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but holiness will bloom on my anointed one.”

133.1: How truly wonderful and delightful it is to see brothers and sisters living together in sweet unity!
133.2: It’s as precious as the sacred scented oil flowing from the head of the high priest Aaron, dripping down upon his beard and running all the way down to the hem of his priestly robes.
133.3: This harmony can be compared to the dew dripping from Mount Hermon, which flows down upon the hills of Zion. Indeed, that is where Yahweh has decreed his blessings will be found, the promise of life forevermore!

134.1: All his loving priests who serve and sing, come and sing your song of blessing to God. Come and stand before him in the house of God throughout the night watch,
134.2: lifting up your hands in holy worship; come and bless the Lord!
134.3: May the Lord, whom you worship, the mighty maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion’s glory!

135.1: Shout hallelujah and praise the greatness of God! All his righteous ones, praise him!
135.2: All you worshiping priests on duty in the temple,
135.3: praise him, for he is beautiful! Sing loving praises to his lovely name.
135.4: For Yahweh has chosen Jacob for his own purpose, and Israel is his special treasure.
135.5: Next to every other god, the greatness of our God is unequaled. For our God is incomparable!
135.6: He does what he pleases with unlimited power and authority, extending his greatness throughout the entire universe!
135.7: He forms the misty clouds and creates thunder and lightning, bringing the wind and rain out of his heavenly storehouse.
135.8: He struck down the eldest child in each Egyptian home; both man and beast perished that night.
135.9: He did great miracles—mighty signs and wonders throughout the land before Pharaoh and all his subjects.
135.10: He conquered many nations and killed their mighty kings,
135.11: like Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and kings from every kingdom in Canaan.
135.12: He gave their land to Israel as an inheritance for his people.
135.13: O Yahweh, your name endures forever! Your fame is known in every generation.
135.14: For you will vindicate your persecuted people, showing your tender love to all your servants.
135.15: The unbelieving nations worship what they make. They worship their wealth and their work. They idolize what they own and what they do.
135.16: Their possessions will never satisfy. Their lifeless and futile works cannot bring life to them! Their things can’t talk to them or answer their prayers. Blind men can only create blind things. Those deaf to God can only make a deaf image. Dead men can only create dead idols. And everyone who trusts in these powerless, dead things will be just like what they worship—powerless and dead!
135.17: They cannot hear with their ears or smell with their noses.
135.18: And those who make them are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
135.19: Praise Lord Yahweh, all the families of Israel! Praise Lord Yahweh, you family of Aaron!
135.20: Let all the priests bless Lord Yahweh! Let all his lovers who bow low before him praise the Lord Yahweh!
135.21: So bless the Lord Yahweh who lives in Jerusalem and dwells in Zion’s glory! Hallelujah and praise the Lord!

136.1: Let everyone thank God, for he is good, and he is easy to please! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.2: Give thanks to God, our King over all gods! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.3: Give thanks to the Lord over all lords! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.4: Give thanks to the only miracle-working God! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.5: Give thanks to the Creator who made the heavens with wisdom! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.6: To him who formed dry ground, raising it up from the sea! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.7: Praise the one who created every heavenly light! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.8: He set the sun in the sky to rule over day! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.9: Praise him who set in place the moon and stars to rule over the night! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.10: Give thanks to God, who struck down the firstborn in Egypt! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.11: He brought his people out of Egypt with miracles! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.12: With his mighty power he brought them out! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.13: He split open the Red Sea for them! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.14: And led his people right through the middle! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.15: He vanquished Pharaoh’s armies, drowning them all! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.16: He led his people through the wilderness! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.17: He’s the one who smashed mighty kingdoms! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.18: He triumphed over powerful kings who stood in his way! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.19: He conquered Sihon, king of the Amorites! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.20: He conquered the giant named Og, king of Bashan! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.21: Then he gave away their lands as an inheritance! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.22: For he handed it all over to Israel, his beloved! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.23: He’s the God who chose us when we were nothing! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.24: He has rescued us from the power of our enemies! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.25: He provides food for hungry men and animals! His tender love for us continues on forever!
136.26: Give thanks to the great God of the heavens! His tender love for us continues on forever!

137.1: Along the banks of Babylon’s rivers we sat as exiles, mourning our captivity, and wept with great love for Zion.
137.2: Our music and mirth were no longer heard, only sadness. We hung up our harps on the willow trees.
137.3: Our captors tormented us, saying, “Make music for us and sing one of your happy Zion-songs!”
137.4: But how could we sing the song of the Lord in this foreign wilderness?
137.5: May my hands never make music again if I ever forget you, O Jerusalem.
137.6: May I never be able to sing again if I fail to honor Jerusalem supremely!
137.7: And Lord, may you never forget what the sons of Edom did to us, saying, “Let’s raze the city of Jerusalem and burn it to the ground!”
137.8: Listen, O Babylon, you evil destroyer! The one who destroys you will be rewarded above all others. You will be repaid for what you’ve done to us.
137.9: Great honor will come to those who destroy you and your future, by smashing your infants against the rubble of your own destruction.

138.1: I thank you, Lord, and with all the passion of my heart I worship you in the presence of angels! Heaven’s mighty ones will hear my voice as I sing my loving praise to you.
138.2: I bow down before your divine presence and bring you my deepest worship as I experience your tender love and your living truth. For your Word and the fame of your name have been magnified above all else!
138.3: At the very moment I called out to you, you answered me! You strengthened me deep within my soul and breathed fresh courage into me.
138.4: One day all the kings of the earth will rise to give you thanks when they hear the living words that I have heard you speak.
138.5: They too will sing of your wonderful ways, for your ineffable glory is great!
138.6: For though you are lofty and exalted, you stoop to embrace the lowly. Yet you keep your distance from those filled with pride.
138.7: By your mighty power I can walk through any devastation, and you will keep me alive, reviving me. Your power set me free from the hatred of my enemies.
138.8: You keep every promise you’ve ever made to me! Since your love for me is constant and endless, I ask you, Lord, to finish every good thing that you’ve begun in me!

139.1: Lord, you know everything there is to know about me.
139.2: You perceive every movement of my heart and soul, and you understand my every thought before it even enters my mind.
139.3: You are so intimately aware of me, Lord. You read my heart like an open book and you know all the words I’m about to speak before I even start a sentence! You know every step I will take before my journey even begins.
139.4: You know what I am going to say even before I say it, LORD.
139.5: You’ve gone into my future to prepare the way, and in kindness you follow behind me to spare me from the harm of my past. You have laid your hand on me!
139.6: This is just too wonderful, deep, and incomprehensible! Your understanding of me brings me wonder and strength.
139.7: Where could I go from your Spirit? Where could I run and hide from your face?
139.8: If I go up to heaven, you’re there! If I go down to the realm of the dead, you’re there too!
139.9: If I fly with wings into the shining dawn, you’re there! If I fly into the radiant sunset, you’re there waiting!
139.10: Wherever I go, your hand will guide me; your strength will empower me.
139.11: It’s impossible to disappear from you or to ask the darkness to hide me, for your presence is everywhere, bringing light into my night.
139.12: There is no such thing as darkness with you. The night, to you, is as bright as the day; there’s no difference between the two.
139.13: You formed my innermost being, shaping my delicate inside and my intricate outside, and wove them all together in my mother’s womb.
139.14: I thank you, God, for making me so mysteriously complex! Everything you do is marvelously breathtaking. It simply amazes me to think about it! How thoroughly you know me, Lord!
139.15: You even formed every bone in my body when you created me in the secret place; carefully, skillfully you shaped me from nothing to something.
